articleTitle: Optimal Global Path Planning for Wheel-Legged Robot on Mountain Terrain
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Nowadays, motion performance of Wheel-legged robots has been significantly improved, meanwhile, the work scenarios and mission requirements are becoming more and more extensive, which puts higher demands on their autonomous capabilities. In the wild mountain environment, both robot power and traveling safety are important factors affecting the operation. Moreover, the large amount of known digital elevation map (DEM) data information and weather forecast information makes it possible to evaluate the energy efficiency and movement safety. Therefore, in addition to solving the traditional path length minimization, it is necessary to define path optimality for these two parameters separately. In this paper, we propose a global planning strategy based on Downward Project A* (DOP-A*) algorithm for wheel-legged robots, which realizes the decrease of energy consumption and meteorological threat successfully. The simulation results demonstrate that three different optimal paths are generated by utilizing different efficiency or meteorological threat weight.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Control Based On Improved Nonlinear Disturbance Observer For Mobile Robots Considering Unknown Skidding And Slipping of Wheels
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The trajectory tracking problem of a type (2,0) wheeled mobile robots (WMR) with unknown longitudinal and lateral slippage is studied in this paper. The influence of slippage is considered by establishing more accurate kinematic and dynamic models. The total disturbances (slippage parameters, model uncertainties) of the dynamic model are estimated online through an improved disturbance observer and the slippage parameters can be derived using a low-pass filter. Meanwhile, auxiliary velocity input is tracked by a sliding mode controller in dynamic surface. Then, an error feedback controller is designed using backstepping method to achieve the position tracking. The index convergence of improved disturbance observer with LMI and the stability of all the signals of the considered systems is guaranteed using Lyapunov stability theory. Finally, simulation examples demonstrate the better effectiveness of the control methodology.

articleTitle: Modelling, Controller Design and Simulation of Quadrotor Aircraft Based on Cascade PID
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The quadrotor vehicle control system possesses characteristics such as nonlinearity and strong coupling. This paper presents a design for a quadcopter unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flight control system. Firstly, the dynamic model of the quadcopter is established. Then, based on the dynamic model of the vehicle, a dual-loop cascaded PID control system is designed. Finally, simulation validation was conducted in the MATLAB Simulink environment. The simulation results demonstrate that the designed control system has a fast response speed and can achieve stable tracking of the attitude and position of the quadcopter, which verifies the effectiveness of the control scheme.

articleTitle: Design of Express Box System Based on Wireless Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, the topic of enhancing robotization, intelligence and facilitation is discussed carefully in an express box system. In order to realize these functions, it is designed from a MCU embedded a wireless transmission GSM moduel. Fast information processing and delivery shortens time consumption. SMS message is sent from processor connected with a computer server. Certainly, RFID system is also designed as receiving and sending information units. Besides, there is a weigh-and-pay system, which provides real-timechannel of disbursement. Totally, our design is useful, convenient and intelligent for customers and couriers.

articleTitle: Damage Detection and Classification in CFRP Composites Based on GCN-LSTM Network for Ultrasonic Lamb Waves
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This research develops a novel ultrasonic Lamb wave damage detection and classification algorithm of CFRP composites algorithm based on a graph convolutional neural network (GCN) and Long Short Term Memory network (LSTM) from a data-driven perspective. The proposed model named CFRP-former, which consists of four modules, the spatial extractors, the graph convolutional module, the mlp module and the Long Short Term Memory module. After using the real-world lamb wave data as a test bed, the experimental findings show that, in comparison to other baselines, the model proposed in this study delivers the best performance across all metrics. Moreover, our model outperforms other baselines in different levels of spatial noise, so it can prove to be more robust to noise as well.

articleTitle: Distributed Collaborative Control Technology in Multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Operations
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Compared with single aircraft, multiple unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) collaborative combat has many advantages and has been widely studied and applied. This article reviews and studies the distributed collaborative control technology in multi-UAV combat. Firstly, the background and problems to be solved in the collaborative operation of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles are elaborated. Then the advantages of distributed collaborative control over centralized collaborative control are analyzed, commonly used artificial potential field methods, consistency theory methods, behavior-based methods, and their applications are summarized, and collaborative flight strategies and implementation methods applicable to different formation systems are explored. Finally, the challenges faced by the collaborative control of UA V formations are elaborated, and prospects for future issues worth further research are presented. Exploring collaborative control methods for unmanned aerial vehicle formation flight will contribute to innovative research in this field, thereby promoting the rapid development of multi-agent collaborative control technology.

articleTitle: Gaussian-Based 3D-IoU for Multi-Modal 3D Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the development of sensor technology, automatic driving technology primarily uses LiDAR and cameras to realize 3D object detection tasks. In general, lidar can provide adequate geometric position information, and RGB cameras can provide rich semantic information. Therefore, using a multi-modal strategy to fuse point clouds and RGB images can theoretically improve the detection performance. During the training process of 3D object detection pipeline with multi-modal fusion, 3D-IoU (3D Intersection-over-Union) based loss term is usually utilized to guide the learning of network parameters. However, the conventional 3D-IoU loss is relatively coarse, and it cannot accurately calculate the IoU between the genuine 3D bounding box and the predicted 3D bounding box. Therefore, we use Gaussian distribution to approximate the 3D-IoU score in the training process to acquire a 3D object detector with higher attributes. Our approach was experimented on the KITTI dataset, and the experimental results show that using Gaussian distribution to approximate the 3D-IoU loss can effectively improve the performance of 3D object detection.

articleTitle: CNN-BiLSTM Based Demand Prediction for Shared Bicycles
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In the dynamic landscape of bicycle-sharing enterprises, precise demand forecasting emerges as a cornerstone for balancing supply and demand. This study builds upon existing research by further investigating the spatial and temporal dynamics of shared bicycle usage in Shanghai, offering new perspectives and deepening our understanding of this field. Our innovative approach combines the feature extraction of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with the skillful time-series analysis of Bidirectional Long and Short-Term Memory Network (BiLSTM), culminating in the novel CNN-BiLSTM model.This model's distinctiveness lies in its dual capacity to harness spatial characteristics and temporal patterns in predicting shared bicycle demand. Utilizing a comprehensive correlation analysis, we identify and incorporate key factors influencing bicycle usage into the model, enhancing its predictive accuracy. Benchmarked against conventional models like CNN, LSTM, and BiLSTM, the CNN-BiLSTM model demonstrates superior performance with the lowest RMSE and MAE, coupled with the highest <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{R}^{2}$</tex> value. These metrics underscore our model's enhanced predictive capabilities. Our findings hold significant implications for bicycle-sharing enterprises. By accurately forecasting demand, this research offers a strategic tool for optimizing business operations and enhancing management efficiency, thereby contributing valuable insights to the domain of shared transportation logistics.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Predictive Maintenance Model for Air Cylinder in Manufacturing Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and manufacturing automation, appropriate predictive maintenance for key devices and common components is important to ensure the safety, reliability, and productivity of manufacturing systems. Air cylinders are widely used in industrial robotic hands in automation systems, from assembly lines to mechanical manufacturing lines. However, the health status and life cycle of air cylinders can be affected by various factors during operations. This work proposes a fault classification model based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for various types of air cylinders. The feasibility of the proposed predictive maintenance strategy is validated on a battery cell pack test line.

articleTitle: Distributed Economic Model Predictive Control of Hybrid SNCR-SCR Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Selective catalytic reduction (SCR) and selective non-catalytic reduction (SNCR) reactors are the most efficient systems for reducing NOx emission from power plants. This study proposes a distributed economic model predictive control (DEMPC) strategy for hybrid SNCR-SCR systems to reduce NOx emission and improve the economic performance of the process. First, a distributed model is used to represent the dynamics of the hybrid SNCR-SCR system. Next, criteria for assessing the economic and NOx removal performance are introduced. Then, a DEMPC strategy with contractive constraints is developed for denitration process control. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate that the NOx emission is limited within 50 mg/m3 and the economic performance of the denitration process is improved.

articleTitle: Intelligent Cutter State Detection Platform based on Edge-Enhanced FCN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In the manufacturing industry, machining is a crucial process, and tool wear is often a significant concern. During high-speed machining, tool breakage and excessive wear can lead to workpiece rejection and even damage to the tool holder and machine tool. Therefore, in-depth research on the detection, assessment, and prevention of tool wear is of paramount importance to the manufacturing industry. Tool wear manifests in various forms, including chipping, wear on the rake face, built-up edge, and edge wear. By developing efficient tool wear detection techniques, manufacturers can rapidly and accurately assess the quality and performance of tools from different batches and manufacturers, thereby enhancing product quality and production efficiency. Detection methods based on image segmentation can intuitively and efficiently batch detect tool conditions, providing operators with a visual interface to reduce their workload, improve production efficiency and safety, and lower production costs.

articleTitle: Research on Mine Dust and Fire Detection System Based on Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Mine dust and fire are the main secure problems that directly threaten mine safety production. Therefore, the necessary detection methods is pretty essential to guarantee the safety of miners. However, existing detection methods are concentrated on the sensors results, which observe the videos or images to analyze the potential risks. These sensor-based methods are easily influenced by the complex underground mine environment and cause incorrect predictions. In this work, we utilize the recurrent neural network named long shot term memory (LSTM) units to dispose time-series data from sensors information to predict the mine dust situation and fire risks. Additionally, we combine the proposed network with a multi-source fusion model, which can decrease the influence from environment factors and improve the detection accuracy. Finally, we utilize the proposed model in the real mine system to evaluate the performance. From our simulation results, we can observe that our model can precisely detect the risks with more than 80% accuracy.

articleTitle: Resnet-BiLSTM Network for Multi-Label Weather Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Weather phenomena usually contained multiple basic weather elements. To tackle the problem of multi-label weather classification, an algorithm, mainly consist of feature extraction module based on Resnet34, classification module based on BiLSTM, is proposed in this paper. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, some experiments are performed on a multi-label weather database, including five classes. The proposed algorithm scores mAP 89.6, CP 85.4, CR 76.5, the experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performances pretty good on multi-label weather classification tasks.

articleTitle: Consensus-Based Multi-UAV Partition Rendezvous in Formation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: A multi-UAV zonal assembly control algorithm based on consistency theory is proposed to safely and quickly assemble UAV swarms into a specified formation within a certain range area. The near-staging area is divided into several partitions, and UAVs in different zones are queued to travel in a straight line toward the assigned target staging point. Through the implementation of formation assembly within sub-areas, this paper successfully resolves the trade-off between the assembly time and the control expenditure. Considering the position difference, collision factors and yaw angle between adjacent drones, the position controller and yaw controller are designed respectively. The stability of the proposed formation controller is verified using Lyapunov theory. Finally, numerical simulation verifies the effectiveness of the controller.

articleTitle: Vision-based Air-writing Character Segmentation and Reproduction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: To address the writing needs of visually impaired individuals, this paper proposes an air-writing segmentation and reproduction system that combines the advantages of air-writing with the efficiency of robotic learning by demonstration (LID). The solution utilizes the Mediapipe Hand to record the writer's continuous spatial character trajectory in front of the camera, and later uses a rule-based approach to achieve automatic segmentation of the continuous character trajectory. In addition, the utilization of dynamic movement primitives (DMPs) maintains the writer's original writing habits while reproducing the char-acters in a designated area, adhering to the writing specifications and ensuring legibility. The proposed system was tested on 15 sets of continuous word trajectories covering 26 letters, experimen-tally proves the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Semiconductor Quality Prediction: Comprehensive Comparative Evaluation of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This paper utilizes machine learning models for semiconductor quality prediction. Five machine learning algorithms (XGBoost, KNN, Random Forest, Decision Tree, SVM) models are constructed, and a semiconductor (thin-film transistor liquid crystal display) prediction model is established through grid search for hyperparameter optimization. The models are evaluated using MAE, MSE, and MAPE. The research results indicate that the XGBoost model exhibits smaller errors and higher precision on the dataset, confirming the superiority of XGBoost in semiconductor quality prediction. The findings contribute to the application of semiconductors in smart manufacturing, offering insights to reduce costs and enhance industrial efficiency, providing valuable references for the development of smart factories.

articleTitle: Early Diagnosis and Progression of Alzheimer's Disease Based on Long Short-Term Memory Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the growing aging population, Alzheimer's disease (AD) is becoming more prevalent. However, lack of awareness hinders early detection, leading to 67% of patients being diagnosed in the intermediate stage, missing the optimal intervention period. Therefore, research on early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease holds practical value. Building on prior work, this study further subdivided the symptoms of Alzheimer's disease, segmenting mild cognitive impairment (MCI) into three categories, such as subjective memory complaints (SMC). This study constructed a clustering model based on neural networks and KNN, and used MAT LAB for model data training, to intelligently diagnose MCI, and ultimately achieving a 90% test accuracy rate. Additionally, considering the dynamic nature of AD progression, this study proposed an improved LSTM neural network method utilizing attention mechanisms to predict the development of patients' conditions across multiple clinical examinations, achieving a test accuracy rate of 88%.

articleTitle: Sensor Fault Detection for Wheel-Legged Robot with Sliding Window Detector
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: As a ground-based robot with high mobility, the wheel-legged robot incorporates a variety of sensors for environment sensing. However, when sensor faults occur, the unmanned robot is unable to sense the environment correctly. This may lead to yawing and collisions with obstacles, resulting in danger. Therefore, we need to detect and identify sensor faults to ensure the safety of unmanned robots. In this paper, we propose a sliding window (SW) detector based on an Extended Kalman Filter for detecting sensor faults. The skid steering dynamics of the wheel-legged robot in wheeled mode are established and an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is built for state observation. We also establish two sensor fault models. For sensor fault detection, we present the principles of our proposed SW detector and compare it with the chi-square, cumulative sum (CUSUM) and multivariate exponentially weighted moving average (MEWMA) detectors. We use Matlab for simulation to verify that our proposed detector has better detection performance compared to conventional detectors in the case of minor faults in the position sensor.

articleTitle: DDoS Detection and Defense Based on PSO Optimized LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In recent years, DDoS attacks targeting iot devices have become more and more frequent. Identifying and defending DDoS attacks efficiently, correctly and quickly has become a hot issue at present, which has important practical application value. In this paper, a LSTM neural network model based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) is designed. The LSTM neural network model extracts the features of various messages and data packets when the system encounters DDoS attacks, and uses the PSO optimization algorithm to optimize the parameters globally, and finally finds the optimal hyperparameters of the current model, so as to improve the detection and defense ability of the system against DDoS attacks. Through experiments, the PSO-LSTM model proposed in this paper is higher than the comparison model in accuracy, recall rate and F1 value. The experimental results also show that compared with the traditional neural network, the LSTM neural network model optimized by the PSO algorithm has a significant improvement in the performance of DDoS attack detection.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Intelligent Patrol Digital Twin System in Smart Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The collection of patrol inspection data in the power plant can be gradually acquired by robots at the physical level. However, the summary processing and comprehensive display of these large amounts of data need to be more in line with the visualization requirements. In this paper, an intelligent patrol digital twin system is designed, which can effectively analyze, optimize and display the inspection process. Under the reality status, through the comprehensive application of various digital twin technologies, the system effectively integrates various process flows of the intelligent power plant inspection process, achieving a multi-dimensional, efficient, and deductive digital twin platform with verification mechanism, demonstrating enormous application value in the digital transformation process of power plants.

articleTitle: Biometric Hash Authentication Algorithm Based on Random Orthogonal Projection and Signature Encryption
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Speech authentication is a biometric recognition technology used to verify the identity of a speaker. The paper proposes a biometric hash authentication algorithm based on random orthogonal projection and signature encryption. The algorithm utilizes Gammatone Frequency Spectrum Coefficients (GFCC) to extract biometric features from the speech, followed by mapping them to a low-dimensional space using random orthogonal projection. In this low-dimensional space, a hash function is employed to map the audio features to a fixed-length hash code. The identity of the speaker is then verified using this hash code. The experimental results demonstrate that the algorithm exhibits excellent performance in speech authentication tasks, showcasing high accuracy and security.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Oriented Dynamic Flexible Job Shop Online Scheduling with GPHH
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the overwhelming trend of smart manufacturing and green manufacturing, an automatic scheduling method is urgently required for dynamic flexible job shop (DFJSS) to optimize energy consumption and meet the green indicator. To address this, this paper focuses on using genetic programming hyper-heuristic (GPHH) to generate dispatching rules (DRs) which can make scheduling decision online to minimize the energy consumption. First, the energy flow in DFJSS is analyzed and two objectives (i.e., mean tardiness and ratio of useless energy consumption) are established, then energy consumption related terminals are designed to offer corresponding information to DRs. DRs generated by GPHH are compared with manually designed DRs, and the results shows the goodness of generated DRs. Besides, the parameters of GPHH are also analyzed for a better performance and deeper understanding.

articleTitle: Design of Autonomous Fire Hose Docking System for Intelligent Fire-Fighting Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Although existing fire-fighting robots have been able to extinguish fires, the docking task of fire hoses has always been the key obstacle to achieving autonomous fire extinguishing functions for fire-fighting robots. Therefore, it is crucial to enable robots to autonomously dock fire hoses to fire hydrants. To solve this problem, we design a new multi-DOF docking mechanism and develop a vision-guided autonomous fire hose docking system based on a robot operating system. When the robot detects the fire, the camera mounted on it can guide the docking system to complete the docking of the fire hose, laying the foundation for the robot to achieve autonomous fire extinguishing.

articleTitle: Vegetable Disease and Pest Target Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLO v7
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In response to the common issues of vegetation cover and similar disease features in vegetable plant detection in real environments, which can lead to missed and false detections, this paper proposes an improved cabbage pest detection algorithm based on YOLOv7. Firstly, a data augmentation module is used to enhance the dataset, simulating data features in natural environments such as occlusion, low brightness, flipping, and translation. Secondly, the AFP module is used as the neck network to enhance the model's adaptive feature fusion ability in the feature fusion area; Introducing the EMA attention mechanism module to further aggregate pixel level features through dimensional interaction, reducing missed and false detections of downy mildew and leaf miner in natural vegetation environments. The experimental results show that compared to YOLOv7, the Improved YOLOv7 pest and disease detection algorithm has an accuracy of 94.2% on the AI studio dataset, an improvement of 25.9% compared to the original algorithm, and an improvement of 4.6% in FPS compared to the original algorithm, achieving improvements in detection accuracy and speed. The pest and disease detection is faster and more accurate

articleTitle: Disturbance Rejection for Markovian Jump Systems Based on Equivalent Input Disturbance Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Equivalent Input Disturbance (EID) is an approach to equate the effect of external disturbances on the system output to the effect of virtual disturbances on the system output, which mainly consists of two parts: state observer and disturbance estimator. In this paper, the EID approach is proposed to solve the problem of disturbance rejection for Markovian jump systems. Firstly, the state observer and the disturbance estimator are designed to achieve a certain disturbance rejection performance for a class of Markovian jump systems. Secondly, the sufficient condition for the stability of the closed-loop system and the method of designing controller are given in the form of Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI). Finally, the feasibility of this approach is confirmed by simulation example.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Self-Locking Passive Transformable Wheel Mobile Robot for Enhanced Mobility
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Mobile robots require high mobility, obstacle crossing ability, and terrain adaptability in unstructured environments. However, most mobile robots with passively transformable wheel lack deformation stability during motion. This work aims to design a passive transformable wheel mobile robot with enhanced stability through a self-locking mechanism, enabling stable transformation between wheel and leg modes. A gravity self-locking mechanism was designed to assist the robot in stably climbing continuous stairs in leg mode, and an electromagnetic clutch is utilized to improve the stability of wheel mode motion. The deformation and obstacle clearance processes of transformable wheel were analyzed through simulations using Adams software. A physical prototype was fabricated and tested on climbing continuous stairs and different rough terrains. The results indicate that the robot has high maneuverability as well as stability over terrains and even stairs with a height of 160 mm.

articleTitle: A Secure Reinforcement Learning Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Method Based on SSA-TD3
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Aiming at the security problem of mobile robot in the environment of multiple moving obstacles, based on the Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic policy gradient (TD3) algorithm, by defining an effective safety index φ and projecting the control signal to the safety control Set which satisfies the safety condition, the safety and finite-time convergence of the system are realized by using the Safe Set Algorithm (SSA). At the same time, Random Network Distillation (RND) is used for safety exploration to avoid falling into local optimum, and the safety control generated by SSA is used as an expert demonstration to speed up the training process. The simulation results show that the proposed method can avoid obstacles dynamically and efficiently, and improve the system performance and training efficiency. These methods can guarantee the security of the system effectively in the complex environment, and have a wide application prospect.

articleTitle: An Infrastructure Segmentation Neural Network for UAV Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Infrastructure segmentation (bridges, dams, etc.) based on remote sensing images has been widely used in urban planning, land management, disaster monitoring and other monitoring fields. As a mature remote sensing monitoring platform, unmanned aerial vehicles (UA V) have become the main source of low-altitude remote sensing image acquisition of infrastructures. However, with the increasing data acquired by UAVs, the large data volume and high resolution of remote sensing images lead to challenges for the task of infrastructure segmentation. To solve the difficulties, this paper proposes a deep learning method for infrastructure segmentation based on adaptive hidden layer feature fusion, which specifically contains an encoder network, an adaptive layer selection mechanism, and a decoder network. In addition, this paper proposes a composite loss function containing two evaluation metrics, namely, boundary evaluation loss and Tversky loss, for training the proposed neural network. The validation of this paper is carried out on a real-world dataset, and the experimental results demonstrate the high accuracy and reliability of the proposed method on the infrastructure segmentation task.

articleTitle: High Precision Control of Vehicle Based on Photometric Gaussian Direct Visual Servo Without Global Positioning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Most vision-based high-precision control methods rely on multi-sensor fusion techniques. However, these methods are often vulnerable to pose estimation errors and fail in satellite denial environments, resulting in poor control accuracy. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel method based on direct visual servo for achieving real-time high-precision control in satellite rejection conditions. The main contribution of this paper is the application of the direct visual servo method based on photometric Gaussian mixture to the field of vehicle control, which expands the control convergence domain and improves control accuracy. Furthermore, the use of LM optimization for solving the direct servo problem significantly reduces the control convergence time and enhances real-time performance. The experimental results, including time and error analysis, validate the effectiveness of the proposed method in terms of efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control of PMSM Based on Nonlinear Disturbance Observe
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive backstepping controller is investigated to obtain high tracking performance for permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with external load torque changing and system parameter uncertainties. A nonlinear disturbance observer (NDOB) is proposed to observe and compensate the lumped disturbance and uncertainties in real time. Then, an adaptive upper limitation is designed to estimate the bound of NDOB and the lumped disturbance to reduce the system control gain. Besides, an adaptive estimation law is designed for online identification of parameter R, which is prone to parameter perturbation. The simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the designed control method.

articleTitle: Traffic Accident Detection based on Multimodal Knowledge Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: To rapidly identify traffic accidents, reduce the manpower required in traffic management, and enhance commuting efficiency, this paper proposes a traffic accident detection method based on a multimodal knowledge graph. By integrating data information from various forms such as images, videos, etc., a multimodal knowledge graph is constructed, and relational graph convolutional networks (R-GCN) are applied for knowledge graph reasoning. Results from testing on multiple datasets validate the superiority of this method in traffic accident detection, particularly excelling in analysis accuracy compared to traditional neural network approaches.

articleTitle: Design and Control of a New Coaxial Copter UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Coaxial copter UAVs have been widely used in different scenes, including Mars exploration, because of their safety, efficiency, and endurance advantages. In the design of a coaxial copter UAV, a typical structure is to choose a closer rotor spacing and place the centroid below the coaxial rotor, which leads to the poor maneuverability of a coaxial UAV. This letter introduces a new configuration scheme proposed for maneuverability, and the dynamic model and control strategy scheme are established. The servo response characteristic of the servo rotor is analyzed. This letter investigates the maneuverability mechanism of the coaxial copter UAV, and the theoretical analysis is carried out based on dynamics. According to the experiment of the tension of the rotor spacing, the control scheme for the new configuration copter UAV is described. The control parameters are adjusted by using the cascade PID control method. The particle swarm optimization algorithm is combined to shorten the debugging process of the PID parameters of the new configuration UAV. The hovering control of the coaxial copter UAV configuration with a faster angular response is obtained.

articleTitle: Potato Disease Degree Recognition Model Based on Image Processing and Contrast Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the development of computer vision technology and machine learning, some achievements have been made in identifying potato diseases by computer models. Potato disease degree recognition is essentially an image classification task. However, unlike the usual plant disease classification, the potato disease image studied in this paper has a complex background under natural conditions, so it is more difficult to identify accurately. In this paper, The image recognition rate of the improved model reaches 97.53%, which is higher than before the improvement. The research of this paper plays a positive role in plant disease control

articleTitle: A Path Planning Method for Comprehensive Area Coverage Utilizing Neuron Activity
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Path planning plays a pivotal role in the realm of robotic intelligence. Its primary function is to break down tasks into executable motion instructions for the robot and furnish the necessary guidance for its operations. Consequently, the effectiveness of path planning significantly influences the efficiency of intelligent operations. Path planning methods are confronted with multifaceted task requirements and spatial constraints. In response to these challenges, this paper introduces a full coverage path planning method based on neuron activity. This method streamlines each component of the conventional neuron activity calculation formula, resulting in a straightforward structure and reduced computational demands. Furthermore, with the incorporation of the weight term for motion direction, the method demonstrates superior performance compared to the unit decomposition method in metrics such as path length, repetition rate, and path angle.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Based on Improved JPS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In order to address issues in the JPS pathfinding algorithm such as the search for unnecessary jump points, frequent jump point selections, and the lack of environmental information regarding the target location, this paper proposes a selectively bidirectional JPS pathfinding algorithm based on a conditionally depth-first search and a biased selection towards the target point. The bidirectional search strategy of this algorithm prioritizes unidirectional searches approaching the target point, conducting in-depth searches towards the target until a change in the direction towards the target point occurs. The results indicate that the improved JPS algorithm, compared to the traditional JPS algorithm and bidirectional JPS algorithm, exhibits fewer selected jump points, shorter pathfinding times, and significantly enhances the efficiency of global path planning.

articleTitle: Skid Steering Control and Wheel-Centred Trajectory Planning for Wheel-Legged Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Wheel-legged robots use skid steering due to space constraints. During the steering process, the tire longitudinal and lateral force are large, and the wheel motor performance requirements are high. Combining the characteristics of wheel-legged robots, which has many degrees of freedom, a wheel-centred trajectory planning method is proposed. The control framework based on the skid steering by the way of reducing the wheelbase is designed in order to improve the steering performance. Wheel-centred trajectory is converted to hip and knee joint angles by the joint angle solver. Designing a longitudinal velocity controller based on PID control and a yaw rate controller based on synovial control. The efficiency and steering stability of the robot can be improved and the requirement for drive motors can also be reduced with the help of the method.

articleTitle: Hybrid Event-Triggered and Impulsive Control for Leader-Following Consensus of Second-Order Multiagent Systems with Switching Topologies
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, the consensus problem of leader-following second-order multiagent systems (MASs) with switching topologies is investigated. Based on the proposed hybrid event-triggered and impulsive control protocol, each agent in the system only communicates with its neighbors at the event-triggered moment and impulsive instant. Thus the communication frequency can be reduced effectively, and a desired convergence rate can also be achieved. Besides, noticing the influence of instantaneous disturbance on second-order MASs, the impulsive system is used to describe the switching topologies of MASs. Subsequently, several consensus criteria are derived for the MASs by using the Lyapunov functional method and the Zeno behavior is also excluded. At last, the validity of the results is demonstrated by the simulation examples.

articleTitle: An Accumulated Error Based Self-Triggered MPC with Adaptive Prediction Horizon for Cyber Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: An accumulated error based self-triggered model predictive control (AST-MPC) algorithm with an adaptive prediction horizon is proposed for cyber physical systems in this paper. Rather than executing the controller update periodically, the next time of solving the MPC optimization problem is determined according to a new accumulated error based triggering mechanism. Meanwhile, the corresponding prediction horizon is shortened as the state approaches the target regions based on which the communication times and computational complexity of the optimization problem can be reduced simultaneously. Given such a new MPC algorithm, the stability of the considered cyber physical system is analyzed theoretically to guarantee its applicability. Finally, the simulation verification results are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Smart Contract Classification Method Based on Label Embedding and Collaborative Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In the current task of text classification for smart contracts, the role of labels in the final classification performance is relatively small, and label information has not been better utilized. In order to make effective use of label information, this paper proposes a smart contract classification method based on label embedding and collaborative attention mechanism. This method introduces a collaborative attention mechanism to generate semantic representations of smart contracts related to labels and smart contract semantic vectors. This approach enables the classification model to focus on the relevant parts of both, thereby effectively improving the accuracy of classification.

articleTitle: Meshing Statics and Modification Analysis of Spur Gear Based On ABAQUS
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Gear transmission is an important transmission mode, which has the advantages of high transmission efficiency, simple production and high transmission speed, and is widely used in aviation, ships, high-speed rail and other fields. However, due to the influence of factors such as manufacturing accuracy, installation accuracy and complex working conditions, gear often produces large vibration deformation in the process of meshing movement, which will not only produce noise, but also have a huge impact on the accuracy and service life of the machine, in order to weaken the impact of countries put forward a series of practice methods. In this paper, based on ABAQUS finite element analysis, the stress and strain analysis of gear transmission is carried out, and the corresponding modification method is proposed.

articleTitle: Inverse-Huber Loss Based PPO algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: PPO(Proximal Policy Optimization) is the main method for solving continuous control problems in reinforcement learning, in which the loss calculation method for the value function uses the mean square error(MSE). At the same time, the reference for reinforcement learning in selecting actions is the partial order relationship between actions, rather than the specific numerical value. Even a small loss value may change the partial order. The mean square error used in proximal policy optimization will focus the update on adjusting the deviations with larger values while ignoring the deviations with smaller values. In response to this problem, this paper proposes an inverse Huber loss, which aims to compromise the adoption of MSE and MAE while reducing the neglect of small numerical deviations by loss functions such as MSE and Huber. Finally, the effectiveness of the loss proposed in this paper is verified through the learning curve in a simulated environment.

articleTitle: A Method for Evaluating Explanation of Neural Networks Given in Heat Map
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Neural networks, as the main component of unmanned autonomous systems (UAS), is now applied in various fields like auto-driving, intelligent vehicle etc. And its interpretability is now gathering attention from Academic. Although some methods of existence, the explanation generated for a model is lack of validation now. This paper has putted forward a method that attempted to evaluate the explanation in form of heatmap by means of covering original image according to heatmap and test if the model can be fooled once the highlighted region is covered. This paper have also evaluated existing algorithms and models with such method and found Grad-CAM performs better than others, ResNet and AlexNet can provide better explanation. The method proposed has made an attempt to evaluate the explanation of neural networks and provide a reference for future works in interpretability testing.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and System Maintenance Based on Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The continuous development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven a new round of technological change, and for the specialized fields, LLMs have been criticized by their “hallucination”. To this end, we propose a framework for applying LLMs to specialized fields. Specifically, the main work includes constructing Knowledge Graphs (KGs) and fine-tuning datasets for industrial fields fine-tuning and deploying LLMs. As well as combining multimodal data to construct more detailed prompts for inference, and realizing multi-hop inference with the help of KGs when necessary. This study takes Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machine tools as an example, by using this framework, effective fault prediction can be performed and reliable maintenance recommendations can be provided to effectively avoid and minimize the losses caused by equipment faults, and improve productivity and efficiency.

articleTitle: Indoor Tracking Algorithm of UWB Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The rapid development of indoor positioning technology puts forward higher requirements for positioning technology based on ultra-wideband (UWB). However, due to the characteristics of non-line-of-sight (NLOS) signals, the traditional UWB localization algorithm can not deal with NLOS effectively. In addition, information in the NLOS environment will interfere with the UWB location algorithm and may lead to wrong results. Therefore, better NLOS processing methods need to be explored to improve the tracking accuracy of UWB indoor tracking algorithm for mobile marker nodes in the NLOS environment and reduce positioning errors. Therefore, based on the time difference of arrive (TDOA), this paper proposes a Kalman filtering algorithm UWB indoor tracking algorithm based on support vector machine (SVM) by using the machine learning principle. This algorithm is based on SVM's NLOS/LOS recognition, realizes the detection of NLOS environment, and completes the reduction of NLOS error on the data in this paper. Simulation results in NLOS environment show that the RMSE value of the proposed algorithm is 0.3219m. Compared with other correlation algorithms, the error elimination ability of the proposed algorithm is the best, which can effectively improve the positioning accuracy and reduce the positioning error.

articleTitle: Target Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5 for Edge Computing Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This paper selects YOLOv5 as the basic model of edge computing device target detection. Aiming at the performance imbalance of the current deep neural network target detection algorithms and the high latency of deploying YOLOv5 on edge computing devices, an improved target detection algorithm based on YOLOv5 is named AG-YOLOv5 (Attention Ghost YOLOv5). The improvement of the algorithm mainly focuses on the backbone network and necking,to improve the comprehensive performance of the model. Firstly, in the backbone network, the Deep Stem module was used to replace convolutions, the improved C3Ghost is named S-C3Ghost(Strong C3Ghost) that was used to replace the CSP module, and SimSPPF was used instead of SPPF to achieve lightweight network and to improve inference speed. Secondly, attention mechanisms were added to the end and neck of the backbone network to improve the accuracy of object detection. The final function section utilizes Wlou instead of Clou as the loss function, and uses HardSwish activation function instead of SiLU, which improves the comprehensive performance of the model.

articleTitle: Intelligent Air Combat Maneuvering Decision Method of Multi-UAV System Based on TA-MASAC
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: To meet the cooperation needs of multiple UAVs in the three-dimensional air combat environment, a multi-agent soft actor-critic algorithm based on the maximum entropy and target allocation named TA-MASAC is proposed. Firstly, this paper expands the air combat environment from two-dimensional to three-dimensional and constructs a multi-UAV air combat mission model and decision-making model in the three-dimensional environment. Then, a multi-UAV countermeasure target allocation based on the Hungarian algorithm is proposed, which is introduced into the MASAC algorithm to explore strategies under the condition of effective cluster coordination. Finally, a 2vs2 multi-UA V air combat simulation is carried out, and the proposed algorithm has proved its feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Reseach on Cooperative Control of Intelligent Unmanned Cluster System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Autonomous cooperative decision control of UAV cluster is a high integration of intelligent control technology and platform control technology. It is the technical basis of intelligent UAV cluster cooperative operation. UAVs with autonomous control ability can achieve a high degree of autonomous cooperation through organizational rules and information interaction. In the complex dynamic environment and time sensitive situation, it can quickly and effectively obtain, process and transmit various information and control multiple platforms. This paper mainly focuses on the cooperative control of intelligent multi UAV systems, focusing on the key technical problems such as the cooperative control architecture of multi UAV systems in complex battlefield environment, dynamic cooperative task allocation, online cooperative path planning. The multi-UAV cooperative track planning algorithm Mcppbev with extended voronoi diagram is used to simulate, and the coordinated trajectory planning of multiple UAVs and targets is simulated and studied, and the simulation results are verified to verify the effectiveness and real-time performance of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Complete Feature Matching Fusion Method for Palmprint Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: As we all know, the single model extraction palmprint biometric recognition information is relatively simple, and the existing traditional palmprint recognition methods are greatly affected by the external environment. In this paper, we propose a fusion method of traditional methods and deep learning, fusing at the feature layer and matching value layer respectively. The fusion strategies are maximum fusion and summation fusion. The experimental results achieve high recognition accuracy and low Equal Error Rate on both constrained environment and unrestricted environment data sets.

articleTitle: A Compensation-Based Polynomial Fuzzy Fault Detection Method for Single-Link Rigid Robot System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: For a single-link rigid robot system, this paper investigates a novel polynomial fuzzy fault detection scheme with a compensation vector. Unmeasurable premise variables are considered, while the stability of the original system is no longer required. Membership-function-dependent constraints to keep the residual system asymptotically stable are given in the format of Sum-of-Squares. Simulation results demonstrate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improved 2D LiDAR Adaptive Matching Localization Method Based on Gradient Features
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the 2D LiDAR reflective intensity feature of reflector in indoor laser multilateral localization is easily affected by the environment, which makes the multilateral localization method ineffective, an improved 2D Li-DAR adaptive matching localization method based on gradient features is proposed. First, the 2D LiDAR detects and generates gradient features in real time after the laser target is prearranged at the indoor edge, and then the laser target is preprocessed by the gradient features. Secondly, the template matrix and feature matrix are constructed and matched in real time to realize the ID adaptive matching of the laser target. Finally, the least squares method is used to solve the robot localization coordinates in the framework of the multilateral localization method. The experimental results show that the method in this paper can solve the environmental limitations of the reflector and 2D LiDAR multi-lateral localization method and maintain its absolute localization advantage, which is characterized by high localization accuracy, stronger robustness and lower cost.

articleTitle: Classification Study of Collapse Accident Potentials Based on BERT Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the rise of information technology in construction enterprises, the need for intelligent management is increasing. The conventional method of text classification depends mostly on professional technicians who comprehend the information, resulting in a significant amount of time and labor being expended when dealing with large amounts of textual data, and it has several drawbacks. In order to achieve automatic classification and identification of hidden danger investigation information related to accidents within a large volume of accident-related text, this study proposes a BERT-based classification model for collapse accident hidden dangers. Initially, the study collects, cleans, and labels the text of hidden collapse accidents. It then utilizes the BERTmodel to classify the text by merging the Softmax layer in reverse. The study's results demonstrate a 92% accuracy rate in classifying hidden collapse accidents, establishing superior text classification performance and theoretical backing for the intelligentization of project safety management in construction firms.

articleTitle: Research on Anomaly Detection of Offshore Buoy Water Temperature Data Based on LSTM-DAE Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: At present, there are many quality problems in the hydrological data of ocean buoys, and it is urgent to carry out scientific and standardized data quality control to ensure the accuracy and rationality of the buoy data. This paper focuses on water temperature data collected by offshore buoys, and an LSTM-DAE abnormal value detection model is proposed. In this model, both the encoder and decoder of the denoising autoencoder adopt a long short-term memory network (LSTM) as the core component of the neural network layer. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional LSTM model for outlier detection, the proposed model can better deal with the long-term series characteristics in the buoy data and reconstruct the input data more accurately, so as to improve the effect of outlier detection.

articleTitle: Knowledge-Graph-Driven Question-Answer System for Basketball
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In recent years, with the proliferation of various sports news platforms and the increasing popularity of basketball, basketball games and associated data have garnered growing attention from fans. This paper's primary objective is to construct a NBA Q&A system based on a knowledge graph. Initially, we built a knowledge graph of NBA teams and players, containing 132 entities, 102 relationships, and data for 30 teams and 102 players, which was stored in a Neo4j database using structured data. When the system receives a natural language question, it employs a multi-step approach involving RoBERTa-based entity recognition, similarity matching, intention recognition, and final query of the knowledge graph using Cypher query language. This process enables the system to answer questions with an accuracy rate of 81.24%.

articleTitle: Unmanned Vehicle Positioning System Fusion of Radar and Inertial Navigation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Based on the two sensors commonly used in unmanned vehicle positioning technology, this paper utilizes the LeGO-LOAM framework built by relying on the ROS integrated development environment, fuses the established lidar and inertial navigation models, builds an unmanned vehicle positioning system, and realizes the linkage of functions, giving full play to the advantages of the two sensors such as wide field of view, high accuracy of the ranging value, and the ability to faithfully reflect the structure of the three-dimensional environment. The positioning system has passed the simulation experiment of evaluating the positioning effect of the algorithm by relying on the dataset, as well as the real-vehicle test, and the system performs well.

articleTitle: Based on Iterative Terminal Sliding Mode Aerial Manipulation Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This paper solve the problem that the traditional sliding mode control is insensitive to the rapidly changing disturbance and can not slide to the sliding mode in a limited time by designing the disturbance observer and sliding controller based on iterative terminal sliding mode. First, the disturbance observer is designed to reduce the influence of time-varying disturbance on the system. Then, the iterative method is used to solve the problem that the differential equation is difficult to solve with the increase of the number of control errors. Finally, the control law is designed to control the system into the desired motion state.

articleTitle: Design of PMBus Controller for Digital Power Management Chip
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The present paper introduces a PMBus controller with an integrated APB bus interface, aiming to tackle the issues of portability and applicability encountered in the domain of digital power management chips. The controller's topology, centered around a state machine, facilitates PMBus communication functionality. Additionally, the integration of an APB bus interface extends the system's capabilities. The designed controller is firstly simulated by software, and secondly, the designed controller was implemented in the FPGA chip XC7A100T and communicated with an STM32F103 microcontroller serving as a host computer. By examining the communication results, the timing accuracy and functional integrity of the PMBus controller were verified.

articleTitle: A SAC-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Combat
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In order to adapt to the needs of underwater combat under low maneuverability conditions, this paper applies a soft actor-critic (SAC) based deep reinforcement learning algorithm to the strategy research of autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) suicide attack. Firstly, the kinematic model of AUV is constructed and the underwater combat scenario and rules are established. Then the SAC algorithm is used in the strategy training for under-water combat environments, and the optimizations of reward functions are formulated for the characteristics of the environment. Finally, through the simulation and comparison with the DQN algorithm, the superiority of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Intelligent Human-Machine Interaction Based on Digital Twin and Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The advent of Industry 4.0 has significantly promoted the field of intelligent manufacturing. New technologies are emerging to enable intelligent manufacturing. However, concerns arose on how to better apply these new technologies to manufacturing systems, and how to achieve better cooperation among them. In this paper, an intelligent human-machine interaction was proposed by taking a multi-axis robot arm as the research object; this is system, intelligent elements, such as virtual reality (VR) technology, artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and digital twin, were collaborated. Specifically, a digital twin system was constructed to connect the digital and physical worlds, and virtual reality technology was used to achieve human-machine interaction between humans and digital models. We constructed a digital twin system using sensor data acquisition and digital modeling technologies, which achieved real-time motion synchronization between the physical and virtual bodies. To enhance the human-machine interaction's performance, this paper also introduced image recognition algorithms and reinforcement learning algorithms to its target recognition and grasping tasks, respectively. We use image recognition algorithm to identify the target and propose MAPPO- IK reinforcement learning algorithm to train and control the manipulator's motion. Integrating artificial intelligence algorithms and virtual reality into the digital twin system, this paper proposed an intelligent human-machine interaction approach. Our findings suggest that an integrated system combining virtual reality, artificial intelligence, and digital twin can significantly enhance human-machine interaction performance. Operators using this intelligent human-machine approach achieved faster learning speeds and higher fault tolerance. These results provide valuable insights for researchers exploring the potential of digital twin and virtual reality for intelligent human-machine interaction.

articleTitle: Finite-Time Bearing-Based Formation Maneuver Control of Fixed-Wing Uavs for Dynamic Target Enclosing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This paper proposes a bearing-based formation maneuver control scheme for multiple fixed-wing UAV s, which comprises the distributed finite-time estimators and tracking controllers, i.e., and its application in target enclosing. The desired attitude can be obtained within a finite time by a distributed finite-time attitude observer. Then, by designing the tracking control laws, all error signals in the control system can converge, and all UAVs in the formation can track the target and do an enclosing. Meanwhile, a second derivative approximator is proposed to deal with calculating derivatives for variables. Finally, simulations prove the feasibility of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: A Mechanical Leg Compliant Control Scheme for Underwater Crawling-Swimming Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, the mechanical leg compliant control of a new type of the underwater crawling-swimming robot is studied. According to the strong coupling and uncertainty of the mechanical leg and the uneven seabed, a compliant control scheme consisting of linear active disturbance rejection control based on the nominal model and impedance control based on the position is designed. The uneven seabed environment is built in MATLAB-ADAMS to verify the proposed control scheme. The simulation results show that the compliant control scheme proposed in this paper has obtained good performance on smooth and safe crawling.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Control Technology of Multi-Logistics Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of cooperative control technology of multi-logistics vehicles in the transportation process, this research is carried out from three aspects: cooperative operation mode, physical structure of terminal data and distributed cooperative decision making. Through the application of unmanned network system control, the analysis and understanding of perception data and the information fusion technology between agents, the multi-logistics vehicles can automatically find the shortest path algorithm to achieve the best cooperative driving control under the condition of unsupervised. We have carried out simulation experiments of collaborative control in MATLAB, and the results show that the collaborative accuracy rate reaches 97.1%, the control success rate reaches 99.2% and other statistical data. This shows that the multi-vehicle cooperative control technology is feasible.

articleTitle: Dynamic Balancing-Based Label Assignment for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Label assignment is a key task in object detection. Recent studies have shown that the results of label assignment have an important impact on the detector performance. Existing label assignment algorithms usually use the joint scores of classification and regression to classify positive and negative samples, but the joint relationship is determined by the hyperparameters which are not robust: the hyperparameters, as a static metric, cannot be dynamically adjusted according to the state of the network, and thus the scores also have the problem that they cannot reflect the importance of the samples adequately. To address these problems, this paper proposed a dynamic balancing-based label assignment algorithm (DBLA), which maps the sample points to a two dimensional plane with the regression score as the X-axis and the classification score as the Y-axis, by calculating the statistical characteristics of classification and regression of the candidate samples to determine the dynamic straight lines. The algorithm measures the quality of the samples by the distance from the candidate samples to the straight line, and classifies the positive and negative samples. Based on this, a positive sample weighting strategy which increases the weight of high-quality samples and balances the regression and classification performance of the model is designed. Experimental results on the MS COCO dataset show that DBLA achieves more reasonable in label assignment with 1.4% AP improvement compared to that on the ATSS baseline model by the above two improvements.

articleTitle: UAV Formation Centralized Control Method Under Cooperative Flight Missions
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Multi-UAV cooperative mission is an important development trend of unmanned system application, and multi-UAV autonomous flight formation control ability is the premise of performing diversified missions. Firstly, the importance of UAV formation in today's military and civil fields and the difficulties to be solved in formation control are analyzed. The formation cooperative control is divided into centralized and distributed control modes. The characteristics of centralized cooperative control methods are introduced. The typical methods such as leader-follower, virtual structure and model predictive control are analyzed, and their advantages and disadvantages are compared and discussed. Finally, the difficult problems in the field of UAV formation flight cooperative control are deeply explored, and several feasible improvement ways are given to guide the follow-up research and development direction of UAV cooperative control.

articleTitle: Research on the Wall-Climbing Robot of TOFD Inspection for Welding Seam of Spherical Tank
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Spherical tank is a kind of steel pressure vessel, widely used in petroleum, liquefied natural gas and other material storage, its body is composed of a plurality of spherical shell plate after welding, and the welding quality of the spherical shell plate will directly affect the service life of the entire spherical tank. With the continuous development of automation technology, and the continuous improvement of the labor intensity and safety requirements for testing personnel, farewell to the detection mode of scaffolding has always been necessary, while greatly improving the working environment of operators, improve the work efficiency, developed a set of ball tank weld TOFD detection wall-climbing robot system. The magnetic wheel adsorption method is adopted to ensure that the robot crawls stably on the vertical wall of the spherical tank. A flexible probe compression mechanism is designed and an ultrasonic TOFD probe is used as a scanning device to achieve good coupling. Complete the design and implementation of the control scheme to achieve accurate and stable control of the robot and realize automatic scanning.

articleTitle: Dynamic Simulation of Magnetically Controlled Micro- and Nanorobots in a Blood Vessel
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, a group of micro/nanorobots is simulated to investigate their deflection motion in a bifurcation of blood vessels by the external magnetic field gradient controlling and the size of the robot itself radius. Firstly, the blood vessel model is established by finite element simulation, and its steady state mechanism model is used to solve the blood fluid velocity problem. Then, a transient study step is added to calculate the trajectories of the micro- and nanorobots without external forces, only under the effect of blood trailing forces. Finally, the deflection motion of the group of micro/nanorobots at the vessel bifurcation is realized by controlling the external magnetic field gradient. This simulation will benefit for the observation of the practical motion for single or the group of micro/nanorobots in blood vessels.

articleTitle: A Hand Pressure Sensing Device for Cable Construction that Can Adjust Exoskeleton Assistance in Real Time
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The application of hand pressure sensing device for exoskeleton system used in cable construction can effectively meet the needs of lifting and positioning high-voltage power cables in tunnels. The lifting and positioning process of high-voltage power cables in tunnels requires multiple people to cooperate, and the force applied by different operators may vary. This paper aims to design and research a non-powered hand assistance structure to provide accurate hand pressure signal for exoskeleton system during different work procedure, and finally help workers reduce the burden on their hands and waist during physical labor, thereby protecting their bodies and improving efficiency.

articleTitle: Active Sampling Planning by Attention-Based Deep Neural Network for Environmental Field Mapping
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Regarding the problem of environmental field reconstruction, a method is proposed to establish the optimal observation position of the environmental field using a random process and complete the online planning of the optimal observation position through deep learning technology. First, this chapter uses a random process method to construct an environmental field model and describes the environmental object as a Gaussian Markov process. For the variable spatial field random process model, the information gain evaluation mechanism is used to define the sampling point with the most information in the field as the approximate optimal observation position, and the global optimal observation point is generated. Subsequently, this chapter proposes a high-precision fitting representation and real-time calculation framework based on a deep attention network, constructs a deep neural network with complex nonlinear representation learning ability, learns the relationship between the covariance function corresponding to the Gaussian random field and the optimal information observation point, simulates the global optimal observation position generated by the random process environment model, solves the real-time calculation of the global optimal position, and realizes the online representation and planning of the spatial field observation position.

articleTitle: RoboChat: A Unified LLM-Based Interactive Framework for Robotic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of ro botics, Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a pivotal tool in enhancing the capabilities of robotic systems. This paper introduces a unified LLM-based framework tailored for the embodied AI of robotic systems. Drawing inspiration from the recent advancements in autonomous navigation, interaction, and real-world planning using LLMs, our framework seeks to bridge the gap between high-level linguistic instructions and low-level robotic actions. By integrating open-vocabulary, scene representations, our approach enables robots to navigate and interact with their environment in a more human-like manner. Furthermore, the framework emphasizes safety and adaptability, ensuring that robots can operate seamlessly in dynamic and uncertain environments. Through a combination of real-world planning, the proposed framework offers a holistic solution for the next generation of embodied robotic systems, pushing the boundaries of what robots can perceive, understand, and execute.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Flexible Joints for Robots Based on Module Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a flexible robotic arm for robot structures. The robotic arm consists of an array of modular elements and is articulated by rods. Moreover, the module element is structured by double-layer hexagon, which is offsetted part of the distance from a hexagon. Furthermore, the working space and motion characteristics of the flexible robotic arm were analyzed. The analysis results show that the flexible manipulator based on the modular element has better flexibility and can realize different working spaces according to the different hinges of the modular units. It is worth noting that the design strategy based on the modular unit flexible manipulator expands the design ideas of the flexible robot mechanism, especially in the application fields with high requirements for robot flexibility, such as detection in narrow and long spaces and unstructured environments.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOv7 Model for Obstacle Recognition in Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of obstacle recognition in autonomous driving. On the basis of the original YOLOv7 algorithm, we add the simAM attention mechanism and replac the original CIOU loss function with the EIOU loss function. Meanwhile our model minimizes the difference in height and width between the predicted box and the real box and accelerats the model convergence speed.
