The results show that on the produced dataset, when using the improved YOLOv7 algorithm for object detection, its mAP reached 82.3%, an increase of 3% compared to the original YOLOv7 algorithm.

articleTitle: Posture Detection Based on Kinect and YOLO Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The increasing aging of society has led to a growing focus on the health care of the elderly. Fall among the elderly pose a significant threat, emphasizing the urgent need for timely detection and assistance. With the continuous evolution of intelligent monitoring technology, the importance of fall detection systems in the field of human safety monitoring is increasingly evident. Our research, based on the capabilities of Kinect and the You Only Look Once Version5 (YOLOv5) object detection model, which help in improving the precision and real-time functionalities of fall detection in video stream. Initially, we delve into the depth perception capabilities of Kinect and the lightweight efficiency of the YOLOv5 object detection model. Subsequently, through system integration and data preparation, we establish a comprehensive video stream fall detection system. In experiments, we utilize a diverse fall datasets and conduct evaluations of the system performance in different scenarios. Our results demonstrate a significant performance advantage in the combination of Kinect and YOLOv5 for video stream fall detection tasks. Across various lighting conditions, background scenarios, and diverse fall behaviors, the system exhibits remarkable robustness and generalization capability.

articleTitle: Design of FIR Filter Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In the signal processing system, a large amount of noise is often superimposed in the process of signal superposition, and the function of filter is to filter out the superposition noise in the signal. In the field of filter applications, FIR filters are widely used in signal processing from the perspective of filter stability and linear correlation characteristics. This paper introduces the principle and application characteristics of FIR filter, takes FPGA as the control core, designs FIR bandpass filter, and uses verilog HDL language to encode and implement, by comparing QuestaSim simulation results and MATLAB data processing results, to determine the correct implementation of the bandpass filter.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Automated Material Handling Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This study addresses the design and implementation of an automated material handling robot, primarily focusing on line following, localization, obstacle avoidance, material recognition and handling. To achieve these function alities, hardware modules for the robot were designed including a main control module, grayscale line tracking module, robotic arm control module, and power module, among others. With the adoption of an STM32F407 microcontroller, an efficient, stable, and user-friendly controller solution was developed. Data acquired from various sensor modules were analyzed and processed based on different priorities at different stages, enabling effective obstacle detection and path planning. In terms of motion control, a PID control algorithm was employed, optimizing the stability and speed of the automated material handling robot's movement and significantly improving its search speed. Experimental verification demonstrated that the designed controller solution for the automated material handling robot successfully accomplished multiple tasks, yielding the intended control performance.

articleTitle: Study On Tobacco Mechanical Gear Modification Based On Computer Simulation And Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the continuous application of gear transmission system in high speed and heavy load conditions, the frequency of tooth root fracture and tooth surface bonding is increasing, so it is particularly important to study how to reduce the unit load of tooth surface. In this paper, based on Romax designer software, the amount of tooth direction trimming, the amount of tooth tip parabola trimming and the starting point of tooth tip parabola trimming were taken as independent variables. Monte Carlo method was adopted and the maximum normal load per unit length of tooth surface was taken as the objective function to obtain the best modifying parameters. The maximum normal load per unit length of pinion right tooth surface before modification, manual tooth profile modification, manual tooth direction modification, manual comprehensive modification and Monte Carlo method modification were compared. The results show that Monte Carlo method is better than manual comprehensive modification, and the effect of single tooth profile or tooth direction modification is the worst.

articleTitle: Interesting UAV Signal Acquisition Based on PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, traditional PID algorithm was used in the information collection by quadrotor UAV. PID algorithm is mainly composed of proportional- integral-derivative control theory. There parts are different in the fuctions. It can be shown clearly by height adjustment and position adjustment. In our experiments, simulation of load and water intaking was done by UAV. In the process of simulation, UAV was shown in a steady hight and position. High stability shows heavy development and application in our life.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Fault Diagnosis Method for Rolling Bearing Based on Attention and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In the field of mechanical manufacturing, rolling bearings are important core components. To achieve stable rotational operation, improving diagnostic accuracy has become an urgent issue. In this paper, a hybrid fault diagnosis method is proposed, which combines attention and convolutional neural network and introduces Savitzky-Golay filter, called Savitzky-Golay Convolutional Attention Network (SGCA-Net). The method adopts a dual-branch structure for rolling bearing fault diagnosis, which can effectively eliminate noise, and combines attention mechanism and convolutional neural network to perform feature learning on data. The experimental results show that the proposed method can accurately identify various faults, and has high accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered $H_{\infty}$ Synchronization Control for Neural Network with Mixed Delays and Actuator Saturation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, a class of event-triggered H∞ synchronization control for neural networks with mixed delays is discussed. We propose a novel synchronization error model by combining it with an event-triggered mechanism (ETM), the behavior of actuator saturation and distributed delays. By establishing suitable Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF), a sufficient condition for asymptotic stability of our synchronization error system are derived.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Simulation of Pressure Difference of Tobacco Machinery Single-Stage Axial Flow Vane Fan
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Fan is a kind of machinery used to transport gas, mechanical energy from the outside, in the fan to transfer gas into gas energy, to overcome the flow resistance to push the gas forward, so it is also called the fan for the transfer and conversion of energy machinery. It is widely used in other fields such as the tobacco field. According to the working principle, fans can be divided into blade fans and positive displacement fans, and the single-stage axial flow fans in this article belong to blade fans. In this paper, Cfturbo software is used to design the impeller of the axial flow fan, and ANSYS fluent software is used to conduct simulation, mainly discussing the change law of the pressure difference between the inlet and outlet of the axial flow fan under the condition of different number of blades. The final conclusion is that the more the number of blades is determined under other working conditions. The greater the pressure difference between the inlet and outlet of the single-stage axial fan.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Obstacle Avoidance Path Planning Based on Hermite Curve Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the development of sensor technology, artificial intelligence technology, and vehicle networking technology, autonomous vehicles have become an important member of the intelligent transportation system. And the path planning performance is one of the main parameters for evaluating the performance of intelligent driving vehicles, especially the path planning and control performance when facing obstacles. In order to improve the autonomous safety performance of intelligent driving vehicles facing obstacles in complex environments, this paper proposes an obstacle avoidance path planning method based on lane translation and Hermite curve, considering three types of constraints, such as vehicle dynamics constraints, comfort constraints, and global path constraints as the basic constraints for obstacle avoidance trajectories. The experimental results indicated that the obstacle avoidance traj ectory planned by this obstacle avoidance method meets the requirements of vehicle dynamics. It has good comfort, reasonable relationship with the global path, and user-friendly obstacle avoidance trajectory, achieving perfect avoidance of obstacles and the ability to return to the original reference path when encountering obstacles. It is a comprehensive and coordinated obstacle avoidance trajectory planning that enhances the active obstacle avoidance ability of intelligent vehicles.

articleTitle: Development of a Novel Low-Cost Wheel-Legged Active Suspension
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Incorporating legged robot design into the development of off-road vehicle active suspensions has significant potential for improving vehicle off-road performance while facing economic challenges. Based on the design of legged robots, this paper illustrates the development of a single-leg test bench of a novel Low-Cost Wheel-Legged Active Suspension. This research aims to explore the possibility of combining the advantages of legged robot and active suspensions while adhering to strict cost-efficiency principles. The objective of cost reduction is reached by applying standardized, systematic, and generalized batch products and implementing the low-cost requirements in the design procedure of each system. In this paper, mechanical, hydraulic, and control systems of the test bench are designed; simulation experiments are conducted to test the function of the test bench. The results of experiments demonstrate that the designed test bench effectively meets its intended objectives.

articleTitle: Continuum Manipulator Kinematics Based on Particle Filters
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This paper proposes a new method of inverse kinematics (IK) based on particle filtering to solve the inverse kinematics problem of continuum manipulators in complex backgrounds. This method solves key issues such as singularity processing, initial guess dependence and local minima, and significantly improves the real-time performance and reliability of the system. After experimental verification, this method can meet the needs of real-time system motion control. At the same time, new solutions are also provided in this field.

articleTitle: A Multi-Target Decentralized Tracking Method with Multi-Agents
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Based on local information interaction, a new multi-target tracking method is proposed in this paper, for the problem of lack of target information and target assignment in a multi-agent tracking. First, for the lack of target information in the initial state of an agent, a messenger individual with information dissemination capability is created to help the agents acquire random target information. Second, based on the acquisition of multi-agent information, a target selection strategy is designed in order to make a multi-agent group track each target. Then, the multi-target tracking process stability is analyzed by combining Lyapunov stability theorem and LaSalle invariance principle. Finally, the effectiveness of the above proposed method is demonstrated by simulations, and it is shown that the multi-agent has an ability of dynamic obstacle avoidance.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Heterogeneous Green Vehicle Routing Problem with Customer Service Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Green Vehicle Routing Problem (GVRP) is a hot topic in the field of combinatorial optimization. In this paper, Multi-Objective Heterogeneous Green Vehicle Routing Problem with Customer Service Constraints (MOHGVRP-CSC) is proposed for the first time, and an integer planning model is established with three objectives to minimize the total traveling costs of vehicles, Carbon Emission cost and Customer Satisfaction cost. Then, a Hybrid Variable Neighborhood Search (HVNS) with hierarchical clustering and Brain Storm Optimization (BSO) is proposed. At the initial stage of the algorithm, the initial solution is constructed by hierarchical clustering algorithm and greedy algorithm. In addition, BSO is introduced into the global search of VNS to obtain a wider range of neighborhood searches. At the same time, 2-opt method is adopted in the local search to further improve the solution quality. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by a large number of experimental simulations.

articleTitle: Student Behavior Recognition Using Video-Based Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The student classroom behavior analysis system based on deep learning can automatically monitor and analyze students' actions and behaviors in the classroom. This method utilizes a camera to collect classroom teaching videos, and uses the Yolo v5 algorithm to track students' movement information in real-time, in order to identify students' classroom behavior patterns. And evaluate the learning status of students. The design of this system aims to provide teachers with more information about students' learning situations and apply AI technology to education and teaching. A student classroom behavior analysis system based on deep learning can help teachers better understand students' learning situations and needs, improve classroom teaching effectiveness, and provide more effective learning guidance and feedback for students.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of the Suspension Guidance System for Passive Guided Maglev Trains
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Maglev train is a new type of transportation vehicle. In this paper, the dynamic modeling is studied and simulation of electric maglev system is carried out. Based on the structure of four-wire wrapped electromagnet, the dynamic model of suspended electromagnet and F -rail is established by using the multi-physical field coupling and finite element calculation software COMSOL. The particle swarm algorithm was further used to obtain the force characteristic curve of the suspended electromagnet under different conditions. A method for controlling the suspension current in passive guidance mode was designed based on the rapid fluctuation of guidance force within a migrating value of 4mm and the quadratic relationship outside a migrating value of 4mm. Simulation was conducted to analyze the dynamic impact of the suspension electromagnet with three factors: track irregularity, vehicle mass, and lateral wind force. The dynamic response of the suspension gap and guide gap during the movement of the suspension electromagnet was analyzed, and compared with the original PID control. It was shown that the migrating value of the passive guided maglev train during the movement process can have a serious adverse impact on the suspension stability.

articleTitle: Wheel Design and Motion Analysis of a Heavy-Duty Material Handling Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the proposal of “Made in China 2025”, China's robot research and development technology has been developed by leaps and bounds, and mobile robots have received wide attention. In this paper, firstly, a drive form of heavy-duty material handling robot, i.e., four-drive steering structure (4DSW), is proposed. Secondly, the kinematic model of the heavy-duty mobile robot is derived. Finally, the kinematic simulation of the robot is analyzed based on Adams software to verify the accuracy of the kinematic model. The simulation results show that the motion error of the heavy-duty mobile robot is less than 30mm, and the kinematics performance is good enough to meet the usage requirements. The research content of this paper provides relevant theoretical basis for the development of mobile robots and promotes the development of intelligent manufacturing field.

articleTitle: A Nonsingular Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Control Scheme for Mecanum-Wheels Omnidirectional Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The Mecanum-wheels omnidirectional mobile robot (MWOMR) is a massive advantage in loading and unloading goods. This paper proposes a robust non-singular fast terminal sliding mode (NFTSM) control scheme to solve the path-tracking problem of MWORR. First, the kinematics and dynamics equations of the MWOMR are established. Following that, the NFTSM controller is designed. Finally, the stability of the NFTSM control system is verified using the Lyapunov function. In addition, the selection of control parameters is explained in detail. Two cases of circular ballistic trajectory and figure-of-eight ballistic trajectory under different loads are simulated using the NFTSM controller and the non-singular terminal sliding mode (NTSM) controller, respectively. The simulation results show that the NFTSM controller has a faster convergence rate than the NTSM controller.

articleTitle: Research on Time Series Data Prediction Based on STP-GAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, we utilize the Sentiment Analysis technique in NLP field to provide the opinion influence factors for the algorithmic model by performing sentiment analysis on the text of the research report, introduce the GAN algorithm which is more compatible with the logic of the temporal data operation, and on the basis of which we add the Text Pathway, and put forward the text-assisted Generative Adversarial Network Prediction Model, STP-GAN. The model combines temporal data prediction with sentiment analysis to reduce the error of model training, and introduces the Transformer structure to improve the learning ability of temporal data features. In addition, STP-GAN utilizes BERT for fine-tuning and incorporates a lexicon to increase model adaptability. And on the basis of the proposed STP-GAN, the optimizer RMSPropW, which is more suitable for this research, is proposed, which uses the exponentially weighted moving average as the decay coefficient and utilizes weight decay to improve the training stability and training speed of the prediction model.

articleTitle: Research on Improved ICP for 3D Reconstruction of Lightning Arrester
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The lightning arrester is an electrical device used to prevent damage to the insulation of electrical equipment caused by over voltages, including lightning and switching impulses. Creepage distance, umbrella distance, and diameter are crucial parameters for lightning arrester protection. However, traditional manual detection methods are laborious and cumbersome. Moreover, due to the highly symmetrical structure of the lighting arrester itself, the traditional methods have difficulties such as easy reverse registration, etc. This paper proposes an approach for obtaining multi-angle point cloud maps by using robotic arm and depth camera, and a quadratic point cloud registration algorithm is presented, it incorporates both the FGR (fast global registration) registration and improved ICP (Iterative Closest Point) registration algorithms. Specifically, the FGR registration algorithm is initially employed for the approximate registration of two point-cloud, and then The KICP (ICP uses KDTREE to accelerate the ICP algorithm) is used for fine registration. The experimental results demonstrate that the average registration time is 60% faster than traditional method with high registration accuracy. Therefore, this method has good Real time performance and robustness for reconstructing lightning arrester.

articleTitle: Lithium-Ion battery remaining useful life prediction Using variational Mode Decomposition and Improved Extreme Learning Machine Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The aging trajectories of lithium-ion batteries show nonlinear changes and the standard extreme learning machine (ELM) results show instability. To solve these problems, a battery RUL prediction model combining VMD approach and optimized extreme learning machine is proposed. To start with, VMD is used to process the original battery capacity, it is broken down into a quantity of relatively stable modal components. Then the constructed optimal parameter combination ELM approach is adopted to dope out each capacity subsequence separately, in which the ELM network's weights and thresholds are optimized using the whale optimization algorithm, and the ultimate conseq-uences are gained by superimposing the predictions of each subsequence. The consequences indicate that the accuracy of battery RUL prediction using VMD-WOA-ELM model is significantly improved, and the prediction results are stable for multiple times, and the model shows better prediction performance.

articleTitle: End-to-end UAV Intelligent Training via Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an end-to-end training method based on deep reinforcement learning for motion control problems in Unmanned-Aerial-Vehicle (UAV) active target tracking and autonomous obstacle avoidance. Proximal policy optimization (PPO) is employed as a deep reinforcement learning method to train artificial neural networks in an end-to-end manner using a continuous reward function. The proposed approach combines visual perception and deep reinforcement learning policy into an end-to-end decision control model. It takes RGB visual images observed by the UAV as input states, and outputs discrete control actions for UAV flight. Environment augmentation techniques and custom reward functions are utilized to enhance training efficiency and generalization capability. The training and validation are conducted in a simulation environment built using the Unreal Engine and Microsoft AirSim. The results of the simulation experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach can achieve autonomous tracking control of maneuvering targets for UAVs with good robustness and generalization. Moreover, for UAV autonomous obstacle avoidance tasks, the trained UAV based on this method can achieve fast and stable visual obstacle avoidance in unknown environments.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Environment of Autonomous Vehicle Simulation Based on Apollo
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The aim of this study is to optimize the integrated environment of simulation test for driverless vehicles. First of all, this research adopts the method of hardware and software combination, using a variety of sensors, controllers and communication devices for collaborative management. Secondly, this paper conducts real scene test and scene analysis based on Carla's Apollo simulation software. Finally, this study uses data visualization and processing technology to dig deeply into the test results. The results show that the optimization strategy in this paper significantly improves the recognition accuracy and simulation rate, and verifies the feasibility of the integrated environment technology scheme of unmanned holographic simulation test.

articleTitle: Outlier-Resistant Protocol-Based Distributed Fusion Estimator Design for Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The outlier-resistant distributed fusion estimation (DFE) issue is researched in this paper for cyber-physical systems (CPSs) with bandwidth constraints. The weighted try-once-discard (WTO D) protocol is used on the sensor-to-estimator channels. A group of outlier-resistant local estimators are devised. The corresponding fusion estimation error system (FEES) model is established. Utilizing Lyapunov theory and linear matrix inequality (LMI) method, sufficient conditions which make FEES asymptotically stable under a preset <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H_{\infty}$</tex> index are derived, and local estimator gains and fusion weighting matrices are attained. In the end, to prove the validity of the method developed, a numerical example is provided.

articleTitle: Multi-Feature Fusion Transformer for Natural Language Inference
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Natural Language Inference (NLI) is a branch of Natural Language Processing (NLP) whose main task is to determine the relationship between two sentences. Such tasks essentially use pre-trained models to ensure accuracy, and many applications are found in human-computer dialog and question-answering systems. However, in some cases where small devices are deployed offline, lightweight model implementations are often required to save computational resources. To address this problem and ensure more efficient inference capabilities, this paper describes how to improve the preexisting Transformer and proposes a Multi-Feature Fusion Transformer Network for NLI processing. The model integrates sequence features and introduces a priori information to enhance local features. It also achieves a comprehensive fusion of sequence information, local features, and non-local features, thus compensating for many potential shortcomings of Transformer. At the same time, it maintains the lightweight feature of the model and facilitates the implementation of downstream tasks. We verified the above point by experiments, our model has better inference performance compared to previous models used for the same task. The accuracy in the SNLI dataset reached 89.0%, while the matched and mismatched versions of MultiNLI reached 79.3% and 78.7%.

articleTitle: Improved RRT * Algorithm Combined with an Adaptive Probability-Adjusted Goal-Directed Node Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The basic operation of the autonomous mobile robot is the grasping action of the mechanical arm arm. The premise of grasping is the identification of targets, and the key technology of successful grasping is the path planning and motion control of the robotic arm. Path planning is the premise of motion control. In particular, the obstacle avoidance path planning of the robot arm is the basic condition for the application of the autonomous mobile robot. In this paper, we improve the RRT* algorithm. To reduce the running time and avoid falling into local minima, the goal-oriented node strategy is added and the adaptive probability is adjusted. The simulation experiment of obstacle avoidance path planning illustrates the reliability of the proposed obstacle avoidance path planning algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Insulator Defect Detection by UAV Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: To address the limitations of existing insulator detection algorithms in accurately identifying insulators and detecting multiple defects, a novel approach is proposed based on the improved YOLOv7 algorithm. The method incorporates several key enhancements. Firstly, the MPDlo U loss function is introduced to simplify the calculation process. Secondly, the lightweight CBAM attention mechanism is integrated into the Hand part to enhance global perception of small target defects. Lastly, the SPPFCSPC pyramid pooling is incorporated to improve the recognition and detection capabilities of feature maps. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved algorithm achieves an mAP of 95%, an accuracy rate of 94.5%, and a recall rate of 92.6%.

articleTitle: Multi-Kernel Maximum Correntropy Error State Kalman Filter For LiDAR-Inertial State Estimator
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The LiDAR/Inertial integrated navigation system based on the Kalman filter has gained extensive adoption in the realm of robotics and unmanned environments. However, the effectiveness of LiDAR observations is vulnerable to disruptions from external factors such as rain, snow, and dynamic obstacles. These disturbances directly contribute to a diminished level of positioning accuracy. In order to address this issue, the incorporation of a multi-kernel maximum correntropy error state Kalman filter (MMC-ESKF) is proposed. By leveraging the maximum correntropy Kalman filter (MC-KF), the MMC-ESKF method effectively mitigates the impact of external disturbances. In addition, measurement-specific suppression is achieved by customizing different kernel bandwidth for each specific channel. The proposed algorithm was validated through localization experiments, revealing its superior performance compared to conventional ESKF and fixed-kernel MC-ESKF approaches. Remarkably, the root mean square error (RMSE) of position and attitude are 0.146m and 2.766°, respectively.

articleTitle: Thermal Image Based Direct Method Visual-Inertial Odometry for Robot Navigation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: To perform robot SLAM tasks in environments with GPS-denied, low illumination, and sensor degradation, this paper proposes a thermal visual and IMU sensors tightly-coupled visual-inertial odometry based on a direct method optimization framework, which is immune to illumination conditions and visual occlusions. To address the low-texture and poor image quality of thermal images, the visual part of the system uses a direct method that can work in low-texture and repetitive texture environments. In addition, based on the existing direct method framework, keypoints are extracted and their reprojection error is calculated and added to the optimization objective to fully integrate the advantages of direct and indirect methods. To further improve the system's robustness, the visual and IMU sensors are tightly coupled and fused in the optimization framework. By minimizing the photometric error, IMU pre-integration error, and reprojection error, a cost function is constructed to jointly estimate the robot states and build a sparse points map. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified through experiments on publicly available datasets.

articleTitle: DGSRC: A Recommendation System Ranking Model Based on Dynamic Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the explosive growth of information on the web, recommender systems inspire an important role in alleviating information overload. In recent years, GNN (Graph Neural Network) has been widely used in model construction for recommender systems. However, the GNN models used in current recommender systems are usually static, whereas the behavioral relationships and existence generated between users and various items in the real world change over time. In order to maintain the latest and most accurate results, GNN models applied to recommender systems should have the ability to iterate and update the information. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a recommendation system scheme using the DGNN (Dynamic Graph Neural Network) model for ranking, and we use a new method for aggregating information during the propagation process between the GNN layers, which is effective in capturing the information in the graph structure over time as a way to achieve attention to the dynamic information in the user's behaviors. We have compared with the current mainstream recommender system design schemes on several real user behavior datasets, and the experiments show that the present scheme is advantageous in some aspects compared with other schemes.

articleTitle: Robot Trajectory Planning Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In order to shorten the running time of the robotic arm and improve its stability, a time optimal trajectory planning algorithm based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed for joint space. Firstly, the kinematic model of the robotic arm is established using the D-H method, and the interpolation points of the robotic arm path are obtained through inverse kinematics. Then, the joint space motion trajectory of the robotic arm is fitted using a 3-5-3 polynomial. Under the maximum speed constraint, establish a fitness function with the goal of time optimization, optimize trajectory through improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, and obtain position, velocity, and acceleration curves through simulation. The results show that the improved algorithm can shorten the operating time of the robotic arm and improve the efficiency of the robotic arm in completing the predetermined actions.

articleTitle: A Survey of Soft Robotic Grippers
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Soft robotic grippers, emerging since the 1970s, have become prominent in flexible manipulation due to their inherent actuation and adaptability. This paper delves into the broad spectrum of soft robotic grippers, emphasizing their applicability in sectors like service, medicine, and marine environments. We discuss innovative designs such as the Claw type, Biomimetic palm, and Adsorption type, showcasing the expanding potential of soft grippers. The review also contrasts traditional fluidic elastomer actuators (FEA) with the emerging Hybrid actuator, elucidating their actuation nuances. Despite their versatile applications, from underwater to medical domains, they face challenges like design constraints and control issues. Drawing from research up to 2023, this review serves as a comprehensive guide for scholars and practitioners, presenting both the current successes and future opportunities in soft gripper technology.

articleTitle: Real-Time Non-Invasive Sleep Apnea Monitoring and Intervention System Based on Snoring
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome (OSAS) is a prevalent health issue. Although the traditional polysomnography diagnostic method is comprehensive, it presents several challenges in practical applications, such as the need to wear multiple devices and disturbances to sleep. To address these issues, this paper introduces a non-intrusive method of monitoring sleep apnea based on voice recognition technology, which involves real-time snoring detection. A monitoring and intervention system was developed, primarily composed of a smart pillow and a controller. The system can capture and analyze snoring sounds in real-time. Once an apnea episode is detected, the pillow adjusts its shape to reposition the head, ensuring the airway remains open. Clinical trials have shown that this system can effectively monitor and intervene in sleep apnea episodes. This novel method offers OSAS patients a more comfortable and efficient solution for monitoring and intervening in breathing interruptions.

articleTitle: Learning-Based Temporal Logic Control for Continuous POMDPs
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) is a mathematical framework used to model decision problems in partially observable environments. In real-world scenarios, such as robot navigation, we often encounter continuous and uncertain environments. The objective of this study is to address the decision-making problem for agents operating in such uncertain and continuous environments, while dealing with complex tasks. We utilize Inequality Linear Temporal Logic (iLTL) to describe these complex tasks, and integrate a Limit-Deterministic Generalized Büchi Automaton (LDGBA) derived from iLTL with POMDP. This integration allows us to derive effective policies for accomplishing complex tasks. In this paper, we employ a point-based reinforcement learning approach to solve continuous POMDPs. We represent the observation, transition, and belief using Gaussian mixtures and the reward design in reinforcement learning is guided by the automaton. To evaluate the feasibility of our approach, we conduct experiments in a simulated robotic domain and compare the performance with traditional reinforcement learning methods.

articleTitle: Research on Underwater Weak Magnetic Target Detection Method Based on Unmanned Aircraft Cluster
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The detection of magnetic background anomalies in the sea area, atypical magnetic interference from carrier platforms, differences in target heading magnetic anomalies, setting of detection thresholds for magnetic detectors, and target maneuvering will lead to serious false alarms and missed detections in magnetic detectors. A method for underwater weak magnetic maneuvering target detection based on unmanned dual aircraft are proposed. Firstly, the interference of the geomagnetic field on the measurement was initially eliminated by collaborating with two unmanned aerial vehicles carrying geomagnetic gradient tensors to locate underwater magnetic targets; Secondly, the coarse positioning coordinates were projected onto three planes, and binary Hough detection including point accumulation and power accumulation was performed on the trajectories of the three planes, in order to extract the true trajectories of weak magnetic targets from the positioning data to the maximum extent possible; Finally, when Hough line detection was not successful, the amount of data to be detected was reduced, so that the possible trajectory can be approximately linearized in a short period of time. Through the above method, the detection of underwater weak magnetic maneuvering targets was ultimately achieved.

articleTitle: A Model for Underwater Image Restoration Based on Color Information
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the acceleration of climate change and the proliferation of oceanic exploration technology, there is an increasing need for a comprehensive comprehension of the underwater ecosystem. However, underwater images directly obtained are frequently marred by colour distortion, blurring, low image quality, and inability to reflect the actual scene accurately due to the absorption and scattering of light by aquatic bodies. To address common issues of colour deviation and blurring in underwater images, we suggest a method to restore these images utilising information solely from the captured image. The presented model conducts colour restoration and detail stretching on the input image post-preprocessing, and subsequently delivers the resulting image via a weight-assisted image fusion process. We conducted tests on over 11,270 images from EUVP, R165 and UIEBD datasets. The combined outcomes of the PSNR, SSIM, MSE and UCIQE metrics produced results of 20.9711, 0.8254, 74.3698 and 0.5643, respectively. It is worth noting that certain metrics outperformed comparable models, such as DHE, IBLA, and WB.

articleTitle: A Monocular Visual-Inertial SLAM System Through the Combination of Points and Line Segments
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor robustness and low accuracy of traditional monocular SLAM algorithms in weak texture environments, this paper proposes a monocular visual-inertial SLAM system based on feature points and lines. Firstly, this paper adopts Plucker coordinates to represent the feature line and establishes a residual model by the distance from the point to the feature line, and minimizes the residuals of the feature line by iteratively updating the minimum four-parameter orthogonal representation of the feature line, so as to reduce the computational amount effectively. Secondly, this paper optimizes the visual point-line features with IMU information in a tightly coupled manner within an optimization-based sliding window to improve the accuracy and robustness of the system in weak texture environments. Finally, this paper experiments the algorithm on the EuRoC dataset and compares the localization accuracy with three other classical monocular visual-inertial SLAM algorithms. The experimental results show that the average localization root mean square error (RMSE) of the monocular visual-inertial SLAM with the introduction of line features is 0.06m, which improves the accuracy of the average absolute localization trajectory of the system by 12% compared to the original ORB-SLAM3 algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Collaborative Imitation Learning Framework for Dual-Arm Flipping Tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Imitation learning encodes skills through human-friendly demonstration, enabling the acquisition of complex skills. During the teleoperation-based demonstration process for dual-arm tasks, operators typically need to simultaneously control two master devices, which will greatly impact the quality of the operation. Furthermore, the dual-arm flipping task includes inherent collaborative constraints. When traditional models are applied for separate learning, the success rate of generalization tends to be low, and redundant degrees of freedom can hinder efficiency. In this paper, we propose a teleoperation-based assisted flipping strategy. The operator only needs to intuitively control the motion of one manipulator, while another manipulator is able to subsequently adjust its pose and radial contact force to achieve the stable flipping of the object. Considering the pose constraints of the two manipulators, we design a new generalized position describing the task progression and use it to drive the dynamical system control outputs for both manipulators. Ultimately, we conduct experiments to verify the effectiveness and robustness of our collaborative imitation learning framework for the flipping task, resulting in an improved success rate of task generalization.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Named Entity Recognition Method with Dynamic Bidirectional Gating Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: A multi-modal named entity recognition (MNER) method based on a dynamic bidirectional gating mechanism (DBiGM) was proposed to solve the ambiguity problem of traditional named entity recognition in text data due to the need for more context information and the inability to integrate multi-modal data information. By using a pre-trained BERT network model and an improved ResNet101 network for data fusion of text images, the Dynamic Gating Mechanism (DGM) receives a hidden state as input and outputs a scalar value as a gating factor. The attention mechanism is used to generate a new context vector on the sequence output and merge it with the original sentence sequence output, thus allowing the model to adaptively select the appropriate input sequence. The experimental consequences demonstrate that compared to the baseline method, the presented multimodal named entity recognition model with DBiGM has improved the F1, precision, and recall on the public datasets Twitter2015 and Twitter2017 to some extent.

articleTitle: Knowledge Distillation For Spiking Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The spiking neural network (SNN) is an effective computing model that mimics the brain's complex information processing and transmission systems. The spike-based computing paradigm is used to emulate the highly efficient processing capabilities of the human brain. Hence, it may be argued that SNNs exhibit superior biological interpretability in comparison to conventional artificial neural networks (ANN). However, similar to ANNs, the enhancement in performance of SNNs is likewise influenced by the increase in the number of network layers, and there is also a corresponding increase in the resources required for task execution. Efficiently doing complicated tasks with little resources is of utmost importance. Knowledge distillation(KD) is a widely used technique within the domain of transfer learning that can enhance the efficiency of a smaller model by transferring the learned information from a larger model to facilitate the training of the smaller target model. However, there is an absence of research on its implementation in SNNs. This paper utilizes the well-known KD algorithm in ANNs to implement it in SNNs, with the objective of exploring the application of the KD technique in the context of SNN s and then evaluating its effectiveness in the task of image classification. We conducted three separate exploratory endeavors. 1. Utilize the ANN as the teacher model to train a student model including an SNN architecture (referred to as ANN-KD-SNN). 2. Investigate the effects of changing time steps on the distillation process within the ANN-KD-SNN paradigm. 3. Exploit the SNN as the teacher model to facilitate the training of a student model, which is also an SNN (referred to as SNN-KD-SNN). Our experiments demonstrate the necessity and viability of employing KD in SNNs

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction of Highway Service Area Based on Temporal Convolution Network and Graph Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Accurately predicting traffic volume in highway service area can improve management efficiency. On the basis of complex spatiotemporal correlations from road network topology and traffic data, a TeN-GAT-T model is proposed for predicting traffic in the service area, capturing complex spatiotemporal correlations in the traffic sequence. Firstly, the extracted data is preprocessed according to the rules, and the signal matrix of the diagram is constructed according to the road network structure. This model utilizes Transformer with attention mechanism as its foundation and incorporates time convolution and graph attention network to extract various features. During the experiment, the model's efficiency is evaluated based on RMSE, MAE, MAPE, and other relevant metrics. Finally, the proposed model is compared with several commonly used models, using the real data of UK motorway service area as an example.

articleTitle: Few-Shot Learning Using Data Augmentation and Time-Frequency Transformation for Time Series Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) that tackle the time series classification (TSC) task have provided a promising framework in signal processing. In real-world applications, as a data-driven model, DNN s are suffered from insufficient data. Few-shot learning has been studied to deal with this limitation. In this paper, we propose a novel few-shot learning framework through data augmentation, which involves transformation through the time-frequency domain and the generation of synthetic images through random erasing. Additionally, we develop a sequence-spectrogram neural network (SSNN). This neural network model composes of two sub-networks: one utilizing 1D residual blocks to extract features from the input sequence while the other one employing 2D residual blocks to extract features from the spectrogram representation. In the experiments, comparison studies of different existing DNN models with/without data augmentation are conducted on an amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) dataset and a wind turbine fault (WTF) dataset. The experimental results manifest that our proposed method achieves 93.75% F1 score and 93.33% accuracy on the ALS datasets while 95.48% F1 score and 95.59% accuracy on the WTF datasets. Our methodology demonstrates its applicability of addressing the few-shot problems for time series classification.

articleTitle: Fictitious Self-Play Reinforcement Learning with Expanding Value Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Neural Fictitious Self-Play (NFSP) stands out as an end-to-end reinforcement learning algorithm tailored to converge to Nash equilibrium in Imperfect Information Games (IIGs). In the intricate landscape of IIGs, where partial observability and concealed information pose challenges, the conventional action sampling approach in NFSP can introduce significant variance in value estimation. This underscores the necessity for an analytical method to gauge the uncertainty of an information state, assessing the variability in value estimation stemming from hidden information. In response to this challenge, we introduce a novel strategy known as NFSP with Expanding Value Estimation (NFSP-EVE). The primary goal of NFSP-EVE is to pinpoint information states characterized by heightened uncertainty and systematically explore all potential actions within these states. To systematically assess the estimation uncertainty stemming from concealed information, the paper first conducts a theoretical analysis on minimizing variance in estimated values through the advancement of gameplay. This process reveals previously unobserved information to the agent. Building upon this analysis, we derive the variance reduction technique that minimizes variance to a significant extent. Through comprehensive experimental evaluations conducted on Leduc and Texas Hold'em poker games, our results underscore the superior performance of NFSP-EVE in comparison to various NFSP variants.

articleTitle: Parameter Tuning of PID Intelligent Control System Based on Information Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Rapid convergence of the control system actuator output is a crucial goal of the closed-loop control system for stabilising and regulating the PID controller parameters. As a result, the controlled quantity significantly overshoots, and the system fails to converge. However, current predictive control methods employing neural networks and fuzzy rules demonstrate inadequate transferability, high computational complexity, and insufficient adaptivity. To achieve an effective intervention control approach, this study employs Liang-Kleeman Information-Flow to measure stable correlations between the controlled variable and its corresponding time-series data. This generates characteristic nodes, which are then utilised to predict the parameters of the intervention controller and determine the output u. Consequently, the control system rapidly converges and stabilises. Experiments were conducted on the Simulink platform to evaluate the effectiveness of a general second-order nonlinear time-lag simulation control model. Comparison experiments were carried out and the results indicated that the method provided high accuracy in terms of control response rate, steady state error, amount of overshooting, and ability to resist interference. These indicators were verified, providing evidence of the method's efficacy.

articleTitle: A Multi-Source Potential Field for Off-Road Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Off-road environments with varied terrain and obstacle types pose challenges for safe maneuvering of unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs). In this paper, the multi-source off-road potential field (MOPF) is proposed to quantify the risk and impedimental effects on vehicle travel in off-road environments by taking the effect of the three-dimensional terrain and obstacles into account in combination with the vehicle performance and state. First, vehicle failure conditions are defined based on dynamics analysis, and crossable and non-crossable terrain are classified to consider the limitations of vehicle performance on various terrain. The non-uniform safety margin potential field (NSMPF) is proposed, based on which the non-crossable terrain source potential field (NTSPF) and the non-crossable obstacle source potential field (NOSPF) are established to quantify the risk, which can help vehicle effectively avoid unnecessary detours and save energy. The crossable obstacle source potential field (COSPF) and terrain source potential field (TSPF) are established to represent the impedimental effect of off-road environment on vehicle traveling. Finally, an application example of the MOPF in path planning is given. The MOPF has been proved by simulation to generate paths with short lengths and match the vehicle performance, while ensuring collision avoidance. In addition, the MOPF can also include different human needs and driving styles.

articleTitle: Air Pollution Prediction Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The formation mechanism and process of PM2.5 are relatively complex, with nonlinear, non-stationary, and multi-dimensional characteristics in both time and space, which increases the difficulty of long-term prediction. This article takes PM2.5 pollution as the research object and proposes a PM2.5 air pollution prediction method based on CNN-LSTM deep learning model. It integrates the feature learning and extraction advantages of CNN and the temporal memory advantages of LSTM to improve the accuracy of long-term prediction of PM2.5 pollution in small areas. Through experimental research, it has been shown that the integrated CNN-LSTM hybrid prediction model can fully explore the temporal and interactive characteristics of air pollutants and meteorological factor data, and has higher prediction accuracy and accuracy than a single LSTM prediction model. It is suitable for deep learning hybrid models in processing data such as meteorological data, stock market data, economic data, transportation data and other big data with time series characteristics provides reference.

articleTitle: A Review of Underwater SLAM Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Underwater navigation and positioning is a technology that provides attitude, speed, position and other information for underwater vehicles, and is a prerequisite for the successful completion of various underwater tasks. Due to the strong absorption and shielding effect of seawater medium on electromagnetic waves, commonly used radio, satellite and other navigation technologies are difficult to be adopted underwater, and the covert navigation of underwater vehicles makes underwater navigation and positioning become a hot research direction. With the maturity and wide application of SLAM technology, in the face of limited detection means and complex underwater unstructured scenes, underwater SLAM uses multiple information fusion technology to realize the positioning of submarine vehicles and navigation area mapping through the real-time underwater environmental information obtained, which has become one of the effective ways for autonomous underwater vehicles to realize autonomous positioning and navigation. At present, there are more articles related to underwater SLAM technology, but they are different in terms of detection means, fusion algorithms and realization methods, and their related results have been applied in different fields with different degrees of engineering. Especially in the remote mission under ice, since it is not possible to obtain satellite information for positioning correction by surfacing in open water, this puts forward higher requirements for how underwater SLAM technology can realize high-precision navigation and positioning under the condition of lack of important features. Therefore, this paper reviews the development history of underwater SLAM technology by collecting and organizing technical articles related to underwater SLAM, researches the difficulties existing in underwater SLAM technology, combs through the existing underwater SLAM processing, algorithm model and simulation, and summarizes, classifies, and compares and analyzes the different detection means and state estimation processing methods. The purpose of this paper is to help researchers better understand the system structure and development status of underwater SLAM, and to provide feasible and effective methods for solving underwater SLAM problems.

articleTitle: Research on Unmanned Surface Vehicle Collision Avoidance Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Developing an autonomous collision avoidance system for an Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) operating in unpredictable environments is a challenge. This is especially true in crowded inland waterways where vessel density is high, and the navigable area is limited. Ships should be able to make autonomous decisions to avoid collisions with other ships. Additionally, reports indicate that the majority of ship collision accidents are caused by various human decision-making errors. In this study, we propose an unmanned surface vehicle collision avoidance method based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm. This method utilizes a Deep Neural Network (DNN) to directly map the state of the ship to the steering angle. This DNN is trained over USV in rich encountering situations using the Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm, which can automatically adjust temperature coefficients. To better assess the collision risk of ships, this paper constructs two types of ship domains: the avoidance domain and the collision domain. We validate the proposed collision avoidance method in three typical encounter scenarios: head-on encounters, crossing encounters, and overtaking encounters. Simulation results demonstrate that the USV can safely avoid target ships and reach its destination in various encounter situations.

articleTitle: The Locomotion of a Circular Symmetrical Wheel-Foot Integrated Hexapod Robot on Complex Terrain
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: With the widespread use of legged robots in various fields, the demand for simplified control and structural rationalization is also increasing. In order to design a novel robot that can be suitable for different terrains, this paper proposes a wheel-foot integrated hexapod robot to achieve rapid pathrough in both flat and rugged terrain. Most existing hexapod robots have rectangular structures, and due to the fact that the leg structure design is mostly axisymmetric, their direction of travel is relatively single. However, the hexapod robot with symmetrical distribution around the circumference has more symmetry axes than the rectangular ones. This symmetry advantage allows the hexapod robot with symmetrical distribution around the circumference to have more forward directions, achieve zero radius turns, and have better turning flexibility than the rectangular body hexapod robot. This article mainly studies the use of wheeled and footed gait for walking on flat terrain for this hexapod robot with integrated wheels and legs. Further research and comparison were conducted on the use of different foot gait patterns under rugged terrain conditions. For footed gait, this article mainly studies two types, one is the classic tripod gait, and the other is the improved one legged pointed locomotion gait based on wave and ripple gait. Through multiple experimental comparisons, the conclusion drawn in this article is as follows. Firstly, under flat terrain conditions, wheeled walking is much faster than foot walking. Secondly, in rugged terrain environments, with the steps above, the tripod gait exhibits significant instability and slowness compared to the single legged pointed locomotion gait.

articleTitle: Improved Residual Network and LSTM Hybrid Model Based Tool Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Health monitoring is crucial for intelligent manufacturing systems to reduce downtime, avoid major hazardous accidents, improve work efficiency, and save costs. The current mainstream health monitoring methods, such as CNN and LSTM, donot consider sequence and time dependencies together. To solve the above problem, an improved residual network and LSTM hybrid model based tool health monitoring is proposed in this paper. First, in the experiment, Wavelet transform was employed as the initial step for time series reconstruction, with the aim of achieving both dimensionality reduction and denoising. The resulting reconstructed time data was fed into the enhanced hybrid model. Then, the improved hybrid model overcomes the shortcomings of the single model, and avoids the mutual interference problem of the conventional combination model in feature extraction. Finally, hybrid model utilizes parallel Deep Residual Networks (DRN) and Long Short- Term Memory (LSTM) networks to extract high-dimensional features from the data. These extracted features are subsequently fed into the fully connected layer via an attention mechanism module to yield the predicted results. The universality and accuracy of the method in the paper were verified through the PHM20 10 dataset.

articleTitle: E-CVP-MVSNet: Effective Hierarchical Multi-View 3D Reconstruction Based on Light-Weight Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Multi-view stereo based on cost volume pyramid has achieved good results in depth inference using high-resolution images. However, most approaches require a lot of computing resources, in part because convolutional layers extract redundant features and pay too much attention to some unwanted feature information. In this work, we propose a pyramid network for feature extraction that is both effective and efficient. There are two main mechanisms in the proposed approach. An effective convolution module called SCConv (Spatial and Channel reconstruction Convolution) to reduce duplicate features and encourage representative feature learning. To encode spatial data and processes high-resolution photos more efficiently, Conv2Former is also introduced into the model to enhance feature extraction capabilities. Experiments show that our method can obviously decrease the parameters, complexity and computational costs, thus improve the performance and generative ability remarkably.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction of Rail Transit Chiller Based on Genetic Algorithm Optimization of BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This article establishes a BP neural network-based fault prediction model for rail transit chiller units and optimizes the neural network model using genetic algorithms. A BP neural network model is established based on the operational characteristic parameters of the chiller unit, and then optimized by genetic algorithm. The results show that compared with the BP neural network, the GA-BP neural network model has better prediction performance and more accurate prediction.

Author Keywords: Water chiller BP neural network Genetic algorithm Failure prediction

articleTitle: Design of Temperature Control System Based on Fuzzy PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, a temperature control system based on fuzzy PID algorithm is designed. By adjusting the system parameters, the response performance and stability of the system can be changed. The traditional PID controller controls the temperature through proportional, integral and differential, while the fuzzy controller deals with the uncertainty and nonlinear characteristics in the system through the fuzzy logic control method. By comparing the performance and applicability of these two control strategies, it is found that the fuzzy PID algorithm has better adaptability to deal with the uncertainty and nonlinear characteristics in the system. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the designed temperature control system is verified by system simulation results

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Broken and Worn Traffic Markings Using a Hybrid Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Traffic marking is an important guide for highway traffic. It is the key external environment element for the environment perception of self-driving cars, and plays a very important role in the correct and safe execution of self-driving cars. In this paper, a two-stage diagnostic algorithm for damaged and worn traffic markings is proposed. The first stage is based on the improved Mask-R-CNN instance segmentation network to realize the accurate extraction of traffic markings; the second stage is based on the inspection results of the Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) and Transformer to realize the diagnosis of broken and worn traffic markings in conjunction with the Chinese marking maintenance regulations, respectively. The dataset used in this paper is constructed based on the Baidu Apollo dataset. This algorithm is evaluated on the dataset above, and the experimental results show that: (1) the target detection accuracy and instance segmentation accuracy of this paper for traffic markings reaches 83.8, 71.8, respectively, and are higher than the baseline algorithms; (2) The diagnosis algorithm of damage traffic markings has high judgment accuracy, in which the wear detection accuracy reaches 98.8.

articleTitle: Study on Improved Dynamic Window Approach for Mobile Robot Under Narrow Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: In this paper, a local planning algorithm that relies on an improved Dynamic Window Approach to address the global path-tracking challenge encountered by mobile robots is introduced. The approach presented here leverages the global path and map preprocessing information to refine the Dynamic Window Approach. Additionally, it harnesses the global path details to direct the operation of the Dynamic Window Approach, enhancing its evaluation function. Ultimately, the local path planning method is deployed to achieve trajectory tracking for the mobile robot within environments featuring narrow channels. The simulation outcomes demonstrate the heightened efficiency and precision of the enhanced algorithm in accurately tracking the global path across various obstacle environments.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm Based on Multi-Group Co-Evolution
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Multi-objective evolutionary algorithms currently face scalability challenges and struggle to maintain a balance between convergence and distribution in addressing large-scale multi-objective optimization problems. To address this limitation and more comprehensively explore the exponentially growing decision space, we introduce a large-scale multi-objective evolutionary algorithm based on multi-group co-evolution. This algorithm initiates by creating two independent subpopulations. The first subpopulation employs a multi-strategy, multi-objective evolutionary algorithm grounded in dominance relationships to preserve diversity within the decision space. Simultaneously, the second subpopulation utilizes a decomposition-based multi-objective evolutionary algorithm with virtual target vectors to facilitate a rapid convergence toward the target solution. As the populations progress to a specific stage, they are merged, and outstanding individuals are selected based on an enhanced hypervolume parameter. Subsequently, the populations undergo multiple loops with a reset based on predefined rules. Throughout different evolutionary stages, the sizes of the two populations dynamically adjust to maintain a balance between population convergence and distribution. To validate the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm, we compare it with five advanced large-scale multi-objective evolutionary algorithms and evaluate its performance on benchmark test problems LSMOPI to LSMOP9. The experimental results clearly demonstrate its superiority in solving large-scale multi-objective problems.

articleTitle: Robust Fault-Tolerant Event-Triggered Model Predictive Control for IT2 T-S Fuzzy Systems with Dynamic Output Feedback
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This paper introduces a dynamic output feedback control method based on model predictive control (MPC) strategy for interval type-2 (IT2) Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy systems. The proposed method considers the influence of actuator failures and gain fluctuations. Event-triggered strategy is also considered to improve transmission efficiency. Moreover, quadratic bounded (QB) technique is used to ensure the quadratic stability of the system under bounded disturbance. The validity of method is verified through an example.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of the Segmented Gas Finger Rehabilitation Training Actuator Based on ABAQUS
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Stroke patients need a finger rehabilitation training driver, among them, the pneumatic soft body drive is the most commonly used. However, the traditional pneumatic soft actuator has only one air cavity. When applying air pressure control, the pneumatic soft actuator can only perform the overall bending motion and cannot perform the sectional bending motion. In this way, in the finger rehabilitation training, due to the bending position and the finger joint dislocation, easy to hurt the finger. To better simulate finger joint movements in humans, this paper presents a segmented pneumatic cavity finger rehabilitation training driver. Referring to the joint structure of human fingers, the air cavity is reasonably divided into three independent parts, with each air cavity applying a different air pressure for control. Then the mathematical modeling was established, and finally, through the ABAQUS simulation analysis, the bending movement of the joints of the actuator was tested. The experiment proved that the drive designed in this paper can achieve segmented bending control, which improved the safety of stroke patients in finger rehabilitation training.

articleTitle: Research On Unmanned Multi-Vehicle Cooperative Path Planning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Aiming at the technical problems of dynamic adjustment and path planning in the process of unmanned multi-vehicle cooperation, the research of path planning algorithm, optimization algorithm, and path planning algorithm based on optimization algorithm was carried out from three aspects: algorithm principle, algorithm design, and algorithm experiments, and the technical methods such as the A* algorithm, DWA algorithm, and fusion algorithm were applied to realize efficient path planning and dynamic adjustment. The simulation model of the path planning algorithm was applied to carry out the unmanned multi-vehicle cooperative path planning algorithm experiments, and the results show that the DWA fusion A* algorithm as the technical solution of the unmanned multi-vehicle cooperative path planning algorithm is feasible.

articleTitle: Development of Automotive Components Detection Experiment System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Automatic detection technology based on machine vision is one of the key technologies in intelligent manufacturing. To meet the demand of the online automatic detection of automotive components, a machine vision-based detection system is designed. The system is composed of machine vision, PLC control, and component transfer and control etc module. The system integrates typical enterprise engineering projects such as automotive components detection based on machine vision into practical teaching, and enables practical projects such as PLC comprehensive training, machine vision and digital image processing algorithms. The system integrates automatic detection technology based on both PLC and machine vision technology, effectively meeting the demand for automatic online detection of automotive components.

articleTitle: Wheel-Inertial Fusion Localization Strategy for Mobile Robots in Confined Pipeline Spaces
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: Pipeline robots hold significant promise in fields like large-scale industrial manufacturing and electric energy production. However, their current limitations in precise positioning and autonomous operation are primarily due to the constraints of the narrow and confined pipeline environments. To address the common issue of noise interference with conventional inertial positioning systems, we propose an enhanced wheel-inertial fusion positioning framework aimed at achieving effective robot positioning for short to medium-range travel. This method comprises a front-end positioning module and a parallel-running back-end positioning module. In the front-end positioning, robot pose is calculated based on data from inertial measurement units (IMU) and wheel encoders, utilizing the error state Kalman filter (ESKF) fusion algorithm and graph optimization. The back-end module focuses on global optimization of historical poses and inertial parameters through graph optimization. Additionally, the system estimates certain inertial parameters during the system's initialization phase. Experimental results show that the method presented in this paper effectively improves the robot's positioning accuracy in closed pipelines.

articleTitle: Research on Cesium Monomerization Algorithm for 3D Model from Oblique Photogrammetry
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: The oblique photography technology can achieve the construction of three-dimensional models of real scenes. However, the individual building objects are unable to be automatically identified from the 3D city model which is exported as a continuous triangular irregular network (TIN). In this paper, a vector monomerization method is proposed to extract and monomerize the 3D building model based on the DSM model. The algorithm consists of the region segmentation, the contour tracking and optimization. Besides, traditional Cesium open-source platform is improved by integration the proposed method to monomerize and visualize the 3D models. The experimental results show that the proposed method can realize automatic monomerization of the oblique photography model dynamically, and improves the traditional manual monomerization operation on the cesium platform.

articleTitle: Trajectory Control for Wheeled Mobile Robots Robot with Longitudinal Slippage
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI)
abstract: This article addresses the trajectory tracking control problem of a mobile robot with unknown longitudinal slip by introducing the slip ratio and an adaptive method for stability.
